title: Creative Strategist Ads - Italia
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

We are a fast-growing international consumer goods brand focused on developing innovative and sustainable cleaning products. Our ambition is to make sustainable cleaning more accessible to consumers through convenient, effective and environmentally conscious alternatives to traditional household products.

We operate across several European markets, combining a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business model with a data-driven and highly performance-oriented approach. Our growth is driven by creative production, paid acquisition, e-commerce and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first** team, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Italy**, a strategic market for our business.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a **highly creative, performance-driven and consumer-oriented person** to become the creative engine behind our growth in the Italian market.

**Creativity is at the heart of this role.** We are looking for someone who can deeply understand the Italian consumer, identify compelling communication angles and turn insights into **advertising concepts, hooks and creatives that capture attention and drive sales**.

Your main responsibility will be to develop, test and continuously improve advertising creatives, identifying new ways to communicate our value proposition and stand out in the market. You will combine creative thinking with performance analysis, using data to understand what works, generate new ideas and improve the effectiveness of our campaigns.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an e-commerce business or analyze marketing data. **We are looking for a creative thinker who knows how to turn ideas into advertising that sells.**

Experience in areas such as e-commerce, CRO, CRM or broader Growth is a plus, but **your creative mindset, ability to generate strong advertising concepts and understanding of performance-driven creative strategy are what matter most**.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Develop creative concepts and advertising angles tailored to the **Italian market and consumer**.
* Identify new ways to communicate the company's value proposition, product benefits and competitive advantages.
* Generate compelling **hooks, messages, storytelling concepts and creative formats** that capture attention and drive conversions.
* Research Italian consumer behaviour, cultural insights, social media trends, competitors and successful advertising approaches to inspire new creatives.
* Develop creative hypotheses and translate them into actionable concepts for paid advertising.
* Create clear and effective **creative briefs** for internal teams, content creators, UGC creators and external partners.
* Explore different creative approaches, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, problem-solution concepts, educational content and other performance-driven formats.
* Collaborate with the Creative and Paid Media teams to produce, launch and test new advertising creatives.
* Analyze creative performance to understand which hooks, angles, messages and formats work best, using these insights to generate new ideas and improve existing concepts.
* Continuously iterate on successful creatives, finding new variations and opportunities to scale their performance.
* Build a **repeatable and scalable creative testing system** that consistently generates fresh ideas and advertising assets for the Italian market.
* Ensure that advertising feels authentic and relevant to Italian consumers, rather than simply translating campaigns from other countries.

### **Creative Performance & Growth**

* Monitor creative and campaign performance to understand which concepts generate the strongest results.
* Use relevant KPIs such as **CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS and CVR** to evaluate creative effectiveness and inform new hypotheses.
* Identify the relationship between creative messaging, audience response and conversion performance.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to understand campaign results and turn performance insights into new creative opportunities.
* Prioritize creative initiatives based on their potential impact on acquisition and business growth.
* Test, learn, iterate and continuously improve the creative strategy based on results.

### **E-commerce, CRO & CRM**

Although creativity is the main focus of the role, experience in other areas of digital growth would be a valuable advantage.

* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate across the Italian e-commerce experience.
* Contribute ideas to optimize product pages, landing pages, promotions, bundles and value propositions.
* Understand how creative messaging connects with the website experience and influences conversion.
* Contribute to CRO initiatives and A/B testing by identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey.
* Support the alignment of advertising creatives with CRM campaigns and customer communications.
* Experience with **Shopify, Klaviyo, CRO, UX or retention marketing** is a plus.

### **Italian Market Insights**

* Develop a strong understanding of the **Italian consumer**, including their needs, motivations, objections, purchasing habits and perceptions of sustainable household products.
* Identify local insights, cultural nuances and consumer pain points that can inspire effective advertising concepts.
* Research Italian competitors, DTC brands, social media trends and relevant creative approaches.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the brand and strengthen its positioning in the Italian market.
* Bring new ideas and creative perspectives to the wider team, helping adapt the company's communication to local consumer expectations.

**About You**
-------------

* **Native Italian speaker** with professional English proficiency.
* A strong creative mindset and the ability to generate original, compelling and commercially relevant ideas.
* A genuine interest in advertising, consumer psychology, storytelling and understanding what makes people pay attention and buy.
* Ability to turn consumer insights into **creative angles, hooks, concepts and advertising messages**.
* Understanding of social media content and digital advertising formats, particularly Meta Ads.
* Ability to think beyond standard advertising approaches and propose fresh ways to communicate a product's value.
* Understanding of performance-driven creative principles, including testing different concepts, analyzing results and iterating based on learnings.
* Ability to combine creativity with analytical thinking and use data to improve creative decisions.
* A proactive, hands-on and autonomous approach to work.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment.
* **Experience in Creative Strategy, content creation, digital advertising, performance marketing or a related creative role is desirable.** We are open to different professional backgrounds as long as you can demonstrate strong creative thinking and potential.

Experience with Shopify, e-commerce management, CRO, CRM or Klaviyo is a plus.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**
--------------------------------

* A genuine **obsession with creative ideas that sell**.
* A strong portfolio of advertising concepts, social media campaigns, UGC ads or other performance-driven creative work.
* Experience developing creative testing frameworks or iterating on ads based on performance data.
* The ability to move quickly from **insight idea concept creative test learning iteration**.
* A strong understanding of consumer psychology, hooks, storytelling and effective product communication.
* Experience working with DTC brands, e-commerce businesses, startups or high-growth companies.
* The ability to identify creative opportunities that competitors are overlooking.
* A deep understanding of the Italian consumer, culture and market dynamics.
* Experience creating advertising that feels native to the Italian market, rather than simply translating campaigns from another country.
* Experience with Shopify, CRO, CRM or broader Growth initiatives is an additional advantage.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Full remote work** with a flexible working environment and the autonomy to organize your work.
* **A central creative role:** your ideas will directly influence how the brand communicates with and acquires customers in Italy.
* **High ownership and impact**, with the opportunity to shape the creative strategy of a growing international brand.
* A key role in a high-growth company with an ambitious international expansion plan.
* A young, international and collaborative team working across different markets.
* A fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where ideas are encouraged, tested and developed quickly.
* Real responsibility from day one, with the freedom to propose and implement new creative initiatives.
* Close collaboration with the central team and colleagues across Creative, Paid Media, Growth and E-commerce.
* A culture focused on experimentation, learning and continuous improvement.
* Competitive compensation, aligned with experience and responsibilities.
* The opportunity to grow professionally alongside an expanding international consumer goods brand.

**Join our mission! We're waiting for you!**

-----------------

Natulim is a fast-growing European brand of eco-friendly cleaning products. Our ambition is to become **Europe’s leading brand in eco-friendly cleaning**, building a strong, innovative DTC brand that stays close to its consumers.

Our flagship product, **biodegradable laundry detergent sheets**, offers a simpler and more sustainable alternative to traditional laundry detergents.

We currently operate across several European markets, and our growth is driven by a **DTC, data-driven and performance-oriented approach**, combining Shopify, acquisition, content, CRM and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first team**, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Poland**, a strategic market for Natulim.

To support this ambition, we are looking for a **Creative Strategist for Poland** who can take ownership of the market and build the creative growth engine behind it.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for someone who is **highly creative, performance-driven and strongly business-oriented** to drive Natulim’s growth in the Polish market.

Our main growth driver will be **creating, testing and optimizing ads**. We are looking for someone who can turn consumer insights into **creative angles, advertising concepts and content that drives sales**.

You will combine **creativity with data analysis**: understanding what works and why, developing new hypotheses, and continuously improving our creative system.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an ecommerce business. We want someone who can **understand Polish consumers, identify new communication angles and turn creativity into business growth**.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **1. Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Regularly analyze campaign and creative performance to identify the **angles, hooks, formats and messages** that drive results.
* Identify new creative opportunities based on **data, consumer insights, trends, competitors and Polish culture**.
* Develop new creative hypotheses and propose innovative advertising concepts tailored to the local market.
* Create **creative briefs** and collaborate with internal teams, creators and external partners to produce new ads.
* Develop and test different **creative angles, hooks, formats, messages and value propositions** in Polish.
* Identify what makes a creative successful and turn those learnings into new iterations.
* Gradually build a **scalable creative system** capable of continuously generating new ideas and high-performing creatives.
* Stay up to date with DTC brands, social media trends and emerging creative approaches in Poland and internationally.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to turn creative insights into **profitable customer acquisition and business growth**.

### **2. Growth & Performance**

* Track key acquisition and performance KPIs, including **CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, AOV and LTV**.
* Understand the relationship between creative performance, customer acquisition and ecommerce conversion.
* Identify friction points in the funnel and propose initiatives to improve overall performance.
* Prioritize initiatives based on their **potential business impact**.
* Analyze the performance of the Polish market and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Test, learn, iterate and scale the initiatives that work.

### **3. E-commerce & CRO**

* Manage and optimize the Shopify shopping experience for the Polish market.
* Identify opportunities to improve **conversion rates, AOV and revenue**.
* Manage and optimize products, collections, promotions, bundles, product pages and landing pages.
* Propose and coordinate experiments and A/B tests.
* Identify friction points in the customer journey and work with the relevant teams to address them.
* Ensure an excellent user experience, particularly on mobile, taking into account the expectations of Polish consumers.

### **4. CRM & Retention**

* Coordinate CRM campaigns and automated flows using **Klaviyo**.
* Ensure consistency between acquisition campaigns and the customer journey.
* Identify opportunities to improve **retention, reactivation and LTV**.
* Collaborate with the relevant teams to maximize the value generated by each customer.
* Adapt CRM messaging and communications to the linguistic and cultural specificities of the Polish market.

### **5. Polish Market Development**

* Develop a deep understanding of the **Polish consumer**, including their needs, objections, motivations and purchasing habits.
* Adapt messaging, creative assets and value propositions to the Polish market.
* Identify local trends, competitors and new growth opportunities.
* Help increase Natulim’s brand awareness and establish the brand as a leading player in the Polish market.
* Work independently while collaborating closely with the central team based in Spain.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in **DTC ecommerce, Growth, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing or a similar environment**.
* Strong creative instincts and the ability to **generate advertising ideas, angles and concepts**.
* Experience creating, testing or optimizing **digital advertising campaigns**.
* A solid understanding of **Meta Ads and key performance marketing principles**.
* The ability to analyze performance data and translate it into **creative and business insights**.
* A good understanding of key KPIs, including **CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, AOV and LTV**.
* Experience with Shopify or another ecommerce platform.
* An understanding of CRO, UX and funnel optimization.
* Knowledge of CRM, ideally including **Klaviyo**.
* A **hands-on mindset**, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.
* **Native or bilingual Polish, with an excellent understanding of local language nuances and cultural context.**
* **Professional working proficiency in English** to collaborate effectively with an international team.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**
--------------------------------

* A genuine **obsession with creativity and ideas that sell**.
* Experience working in **DTC brands, startups or high-growth companies**.
* Experience with UGC content, social media ads or creative testing.
* The ability to move quickly from **idea concept test learning iteration**.
* Strong analytical skills without losing your creative edge.
* Experience launching or scaling a market.
* A strong understanding of Polish consumer behavior, digital trends and local advertising conventions.
* The ability to identify creative opportunities through customer feedback, performance data and competitive analysis.

title: Creative Strategist & Storyteller - YouTube + Instagram
description:
**Creative Strategist & Storyteller**
=====================================

En Natulim mejoramos los productos clásicos de limpieza. Creamos productos sin residuos, prácticos de utilizar y con ingredientes buenos para la piel y el planeta.

Nuestro producto estrella es un detergente para la ropa en formato de **tiras biodegradables** que se disuelven en la lavadora.

**Sobre el rol**
----------------

Buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist & Storyteller** para desarrollar conceptos creativos que conviertan y elevar el nivel de nuestros contenido en vídeo: Meta, Ads y YouTube.

Buscamos una persona que combine **criterio creativo, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**, capaz de detectar qué hace que un contenido funcione, transformar insights en conceptos potentes y convertirlos en piezas de vídeo que generen resultados.

El objetivo no es simplemente crear vídeos bonitos: es **crear anuncios que capten la atención, mantengan la retención y conviertan**.

Trabajarás principalmente con formatos de **Meta, YouTube y otras plataformas de paid social**, desarrollando conceptos tanto para vídeo short form como long form.

**No es un rol de UGC ni de influencer marketing.**  
Es un rol de **Creative Strategy Concept Hook Narrative Execution Testing Learning.**

**Responsabilidades**
---------------------

* Definir la **estrategia creativa de nuestros anuncios de vídeo**.
* Desarrollar conceptos, ángulos y campañas orientadas a performance.
* Crear **hooks** capaces de captar la atención en los primeros segundos.
* Escribir guiones y estructuras para anuncios **short y long form**.
* Diseñar diferentes narrativas, mensajes y formatos para testar.
* Transformar insights de consumidor, producto y performance en nuevas ideas creativas.
* **Analizar anuncios propios y de la competencia para detectar** **qué funciona, por qué funciona y cómo podemos mejorarlo**.
* **Analizar métricas creativas como CTR, hook rate, retention, CVR, CPA/ROAS** **y utilizar estos aprendizajes para iterar.**
* Crear sistemas de testing de diferentes hooks, claims, estructuras, mensajes y CTAs.
* Detectar tendencias y formatos relevantes y adaptarlos a la marca sin perder el foco en conversión.

title: Creative Strategist E-commerce - Rumania
description:
### **About Natulim**

Natulim is a fast-growing European brand of eco-friendly cleaning products. Our ambition is to become **the leading eco-cleaning brand in Europe**, building a strong, innovative and consumer-centric DTC brand.

Our flagship product, **biodegradable laundry detergent sheets**, offers a simpler and more sustainable alternative to traditional laundry detergents.

We currently operate across several European markets, and our growth is driven by a **DTC, data-driven and highly performance-oriented approach**, combining Shopify, acquisition, content, CRM and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first** team, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Romania**, a strategic market for Natulim.

### **The Role**

We are looking for a **highly creative, performance-driven and business-oriented** person to lead Natulim's growth in the Romanian market.

The main growth engine for the market will be **creating, testing and optimizing our advertising creatives**. We are therefore looking for someone who can turn consumer insights into **creative angles, advertising concepts and content that drives sales**.

You will combine **creativity and data analysis**: understanding what works, identifying why it works, developing new hypotheses and continuously evolving our creative system.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an ecommerce business. We are looking for someone who can **deeply understand the Romanian consumer, identify new communication angles and turn creativity into business growth.**

### **Your Responsibilities**

**Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Regularly analyze campaign and creative performance to identify the **angles, hooks, formats and messages** that drive results.
* Identify new creative opportunities based on **data, consumer insights, trends, competitors and Romanian culture**.
* Develop new creative hypotheses and propose new advertising concepts adapted to the Romanian market.
* Create **creative briefs** and collaborate with internal teams, creators and partners to produce new ads.
* Develop and test different **angles, hooks, formats, messages and value propositions**.
* Identify the elements that make a creative successful and turn learnings into new iterations.
* Gradually build a **scalable creative system** capable of continuously generating new ideas and creatives for the Romanian market.
* Stay up to date with **Romanian DTC brands, social media trends and new creative approaches**.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to turn creative insights into **profitable growth and acquisition**.

**Growth & Performance**

* Track key acquisition and performance KPIs: **CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV**, etc.
* Understand the relationship between creative performance, acquisition and ecommerce conversion.
* Identify funnel friction points and propose actions to improve overall performance.
* Prioritize initiatives based on their **potential business impact**.
* Analyze the performance of the Romanian market and turn data into concrete recommendations.
* Test, learn, iterate and scale the initiatives that work.

* Identify opportunities to improve **conversion rate, AOV and revenue**.
* Manage and optimize products, collections, promotions, bundles, product pages and landing pages.
* Propose and coordinate experiments and A/B tests.
* Identify friction throughout the customer journey and work with the relevant teams to solve it.

* Continuously adapt the ecommerce experience to **Romanian consumer expectations, purchasing habits and market dynamics**.

* Coordinate CRM campaigns and automations in **Klaviyo**.
* Ensure consistency between acquisition campaigns and the customer journey.
* Identify opportunities to improve **retention, reactivation and LTV**.
* Collaborate with the relevant teams to maximize the value generated by each customer.
* Adapt CRM messaging and customer journeys to the **Romanian market and consumer behaviour**.

* Develop a deep understanding of the **Romanian consumer**, including their needs, motivations, objections and purchasing habits.
* Adapt messaging, creatives and value propositions to the Romanian market.
* Identify new growth opportunities and help establish Natulim as a leading eco-cleaning brand in Romania.
* Develop a strong understanding of **local competitors, DTC brands, market trends and cultural specificities**.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate Natulim within the Romanian cleaning and sustainability market.
* Work autonomously while collaborating closely with the central team based in Spain.

### **About You**

* Experience in **DTC ecommerce, Growth, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing or a similar environment**.
* Strong creative mindset and the ability to **generate ideas, angles and advertising concepts**.
* Experience creating, testing or optimizing **digital advertising creatives**.
* Strong understanding of **Meta Ads and the main Performance Marketing channels**.
* Ability to analyze performance and turn data into **creative and business insights**.
* Strong understanding of key KPIs such as **CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, AOV and LTV**.
* Hands-on experience with **Shopify or another ecommerce platform**, ideally in a DTC environment.
* Strong interest in **CRO, UX and funnel optimization**.
* Experience with CRM and ideally **Klaviyo**.
* Ability to work in a **hands-on, autonomous and highly ownership-driven** environment.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a **fast-paced and constantly evolving environment**.
* **Native Romanian speaker and professional English.**
* Spanish is a plus, but **not required**.

### **What Will Make You Stand Out**

* A genuine **obsession with creativity and ideas that sell**.
* Experience in **DTC, startups or high-growth brands**.
* Experience creating **UGC content, social media ads or running creative testing frameworks**.
* Ability to move quickly from **idea concept test learning iteration**.
* Strong analytical thinking without losing your creative mindset.
* Experience launching, developing or growing a **local market**.
* Deep understanding of the **Romanian consumer, culture and market dynamics**.
* Experience working with or growing **Romanian DTC or consumer brands**.
* A strong understanding of how to create advertising that feels **native to the Romanian market**, rather than simply translating campaigns from another country.

### **What We Offer**

* **Full remote work** with a flexible working environment and the autonomy to organize your work.
* **High ownership and impact:** you will have the opportunity to take full ownership of the Romanian market and directly influence its growth.
* **A key role in a high-growth company** with an ambitious international expansion plan.
* **A young, international and collaborative team** working across different European markets.
* **A fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment** where ideas are encouraged and tested quickly.
* **Real responsibility from day one**, with the freedom to make decisions and implement new initiatives.
* The opportunity to **build and shape a market from the ground up**, rather than simply managing an already established operation.
* Close collaboration with the **central team in Spain** across Growth, Paid Media, Creative, Ecommerce and CRM.
* A culture focused on **experimentation, learning and continuous improvement**.
* **Competitive compensation**, aligned with experience and responsibilities.
* The opportunity to grow professionally alongside a **rapidly expanding European DTC brand**.

description:
**Homa** is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**The opportunity**

At Homa, AI is already part of how we make ads, playables and 3D assets. Now we need someone to turn it into a system that moves business results: faster wins, lower CPI (cost per install) and lower cost per winning ad.

You'll join our Creatives team and report to our Head of Creatives. You'll own the full cycle, from idea and brief to finished ad, and you'll work closely with UA, data and creative leads. You'll have access to the best AI models and tools from day one.

*Contract setup: This is a full-time opportunity. The contractual arrangement will be B2B/freelance only.*

**Your responsibilities**

* **Map.** Map our creative cycle (insights, production, testing, learnings) and find where AI saves the most time or lifts performance.
* **Build.** Build and own end-to-end AI pipelines and automations, from hypothesis to tool choice to rollout in the team.
* **Produce.** Come up with ideas, write briefs, and produce AI creatives yourself (video, playables, 3D), turning ideas into ads that win.
* **Raise.** Set the quality bar for the team, and push AI output until it's on-brand and stops the scroll.
* **Measure.** Choose what to automate with UA, data and creative leads, then measure the impact on speed, cost and performance.
* **Scout.** Keep testing new AI models and tools like Veo, Sora, Kling and Runway, and turn the useful ones into team workflows.
* **Scale.** Design workflows that scale across games, and train the team so they can use them without you.

  
**Requirements**

**What we look for**

* **Ownership.** You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
* **Proactive.** You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
* **Pragmatism.** You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
* **Sharp thinking.** You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
* **AI-driven.** AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
* **Motivated.** You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

**For this role, you'll also bring**

* 3+ years in motion or video design, ideally on ads, with a portfolio that includes AI-made work.
* Visual taste. You can tell a good ad from a generic one, and you finish AI output by hand when it needs it.
* Hands-on AI video skills, plus strong After Effects or similar motion tools.
* A gaming background. You know mobile games, ideally hybrid-casual or casual, and what makes players tap.
* Critical and marketing thinking. You think in hooks, audiences and performance data, not just assets.
* Systems and automation expertise. You don't just make AI creatives, you design workflows that scale across games.
* Full autonomy. You spot problems, decide, ship and report without being managed day to day.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* UA or performance creative experience, ideally with winning ads on networks like AppLovin.
* Hands-on experience with Blender or other 3D tools, Unity, or playable ad tools.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

 **Benefits**

**Why Homa**

* **Exceptional growth.** We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Your scope and your rewards grow with what you deliver, not with tenure.
* **Real ownership.** No layers between you and the result. You own outcomes, not tasks, whatever your level.
* **Direct impact.** Your work moves the business and shapes where Homa goes next. Decisions are made fast, and you see the results in the numbers.
* **AI at the core.** With access to the best AI tools, you'll help shape how an AI-first company works, and your time goes where your judgment matters most.
* **High talent bar.** Our teams are small with people from the best companies, and the talent around you will push you to grow.

**What we offer**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive benefits.** Depending on where you're based, you'll get perks such as health insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym membership, and more.
* **A brand-new Paris HQ.** A desk in our new office in the heart of Paris, whenever you want to work side by side with the team.
* **An international team.** Work in English with top talent from 35+ countries across Europe, the UK, the US, and beyond. Our diversity fuels our creativity.
* **Team gatherings.** We value time together beyond the screen. Join regular team gatherings and off-site retreats to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance reviews.** Every six months, we look back at your progress, recognise your wins, and agree on clear goals for what's next.
* **Equipment support.** From day one, you get everything you need to do your best work, including a home office allowance if you work remotely.

**Where we hire**

Our Paris HQ is a lively hub for creativity, collaboration, and connection. From lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, it's a space people genuinely enjoy, in our brand-new office in the heart of Paris (awesome energy and snacks included).

We also have great teammates across Europe, from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you work from home in Barcelona or Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we mainly hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there, or planning to be, we'd love to hear from you!

* Partner with customers on live work to scope, build, and ship custom automations and agents, embedded in their team and tools or on our platform.

title: Creative Director
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
  
  
We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.
  
  
Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.
  
  
We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.
  
  
If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.
  
  
****The Role****
Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.
  
  
Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.
  
  
This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.
  
  
You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for
* Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice
* Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember
* Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot
* Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product
* Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.
* Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work
* Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

****What We're Looking For****

* 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client
* You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it
* A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone
* Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class
* Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week
* Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business
* You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and speed, communicate clearly, and can hold an idea through founder and sales feedback

****Nice to Have****

* Brand experience at a B2B software or fintech company known for its design
* Experience working with or for CPG brands
* Motion design and video editing
* Designing and building websites in a no-code tool
* Experience leading designers or managing freelancers and agencies
* AI tools in your creative workflow, used as a multiplier rather than a gimmick

****🌴 Perks + Benefits****

* Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
* Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
* Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
* Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
* 401(k) through Vestwell
* Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
* Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
* Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

**Experience Innovation & Data Informed Design**

* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next-generation interaction models, including AI-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real-time sports feed integrations.
* Data-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.

**Your Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world-class, large-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling & Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.

title: Design Director

* Shape strategy into creative: turn research and messy inputs into compelling concepts and clear directions

title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
Forbes Advisor is hiring a Director, AI Creative to design and implement how the Creative team uses AI to improve the quality and the quantity of our work across our social verticals. As this is a new department within the Creative team, you will define its function, build the systems that run it, and hire and oversee the required team. The ideal candidate has deep expertise spanning generative AI and tooling, direct response creative, and leadership of creative teams. You and your team will work across Forbes’ portfolio of verticals, partnering with Creative Directors who own end-to-end vertical creative strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design the strategy, team structure, and systems for embedding AI tools in the creative process, with a focus on producing a high volume of generative AI content designed for paid social creative.
* Own generative output end to end for paid social and native: stills that hold the same character across every shot, AI video, lip-sync, and generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to organized, tagged, editor-ready footage. Set the quality bar for generated work and enforce it.
* Architect the systems that make generation scale past any one person: pipelines, prompt libraries, character reference libraries, internal tooling, and the automation that connects them.
* Measure how well AI content, and the systems that produce it, are working. What a finished asset costs to make, how long a job takes from approved script to editor handoff, how often work is accepted on the first pass, and how generated work performs in market against everything else we run.
* Help raise the AI fluency of the whole creative team. Work with Creative Directors and their teams to design AI-enabled tools, systems, processes that improve quality and quantity of output.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in creative, production, or content, with at least the last 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production. You have stood up an AI capability inside a creative org before.
* A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built, and you can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted work that ran as paid creative, with an honest account of what you made versus what the model made, and how it performed. You can hold character and continuity across a whole spot, work out why a render broke instead of re-rolling blindly, and get work through platform filters yourself.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative tools: image models that can hold several characters consistent, AI video both with and without native audio, lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on the trade-offs, not a list of tool names.
* You architect the tooling. You can map out the systems and automations the team needs, build working versions yourself in tools like n8n, Gumloop, or Make, and brief engineering clearly enough that they can build the rest.
* Experience leading people or a function, whether as a manager, a team lead, or the person who built a capability others came to depend on. You can make the case for a hire and then hold the bar you set.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails: regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, and partner brand guardrails.
* Clear written communication, and the confidence to hold your position with senior people outside Creative, including the buyers and the executive team.
* Comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools, and sometimes the plan, change under you.

****STRONG PLUSES****

* Video editing or motion and VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of forming a real point of view on brand-new tools fast, because these tools turn over monthly.

title: Creative Director, Motion - The Heist
description:
**Who We Are**
Hi! We’re The Heist, the motion design, live action, and post production studio within Thinkingbox, the Brief-to-Built agency.
  
  
We bring together directors, designers, animators, editors, and technologists to create work that moves. From brand films to broadcast spots to social campaigns and experiential content, our team blends craft and curiosity to push ideas further. Across our studios, collaboration is real, feedback is open, and culture matters. We take the work seriously. Ourselves, a little less so.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Heist is on the hunt for an exceptional, hands-on Creative Director, Motion, to join our team in Mexico City. In this role, you’ll lead a tight-knit team of motion designers, crafting visually stunning 2D and 3D motion graphics and animation for high-impact marketing campaigns. Reporting to the Director of Animation, you will work on advertising projects for a diverse range of clients, ensuring each campaign’s creative vision aligns seamlessly with client goals. Your role includes hands-on creation, storyboarding, and collaboration with our animation team, as well as client-facing responsibilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead and inspire a nimble team of motion designers and guiding projects with a strong creative direction
* Be hands on and demonstrate intention when needed, be it in design or animation
* Develop clear storyboards and polished styleframes that convey the narrative and aesthetic of each campaign
* Oversee and participate in creating campaign assets, including 2D and 3D animation, ensuring all work aligns with brand guidelines and art direction
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to team members, fostering growth and maintaining the highest quality of work
* Engage directly with clients, interpreting their needs and providing creative insights throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with the motion team to adopt new processes and workflows that meet the unique demands of each marketing campaign
* Contribute to project budgeting and resource planning to ensure efficiency

**What You’ll Bring**

* A portfolio showcasing a refined taste in motion design in 2D and 3D across varied marketing and campaign styles
* A desire to further your skills driven by your own curiosity
* 8+ years of experience in a motion design role, with 3+ years in a leadership or senior capacity
* Strong proficiency in Cinema 4D and Redshift
* Demonstrated ability to create clear storyboards and refined styleframes that align with campaign goals
* Mastery of the Adobe Suite (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator) and a thorough understanding of the animation pipeline
* Strong design sensibilities, demonstrating the ability to merge aesthetic and technical skills
* Working knowledge of XParticles, Marvelous Designer, and/or Houdini is a big plus
* Working knowledge of Figma
* Strong organizational skills, with a solution-oriented approach to creative and technical challenges

**Additional Info**

* Monday - Thursday in office (Fridays are remote optional)
* Flexible time off, including paid vacation and sick days
* Consistent culture and team-building events
* Employee recognition and incentive programs
* Seasonal celebrations and gatherings throughout the year
* Office lunches
* Branded company swag
* Access to industry events, learning opportunities, and non-profit outreaches
* Dog-friendly offices
* Unlimited coffee, drinks, and snacks
* Flex work and travel options
* Comprehensive extended health benefits

**Equal Opportunity**
At The Heist, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity is our creative strength - it's the range of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds that fuels our best ideas and most innovative solutions. We welcome and encourage applicants of all races, ethnicities, genders, identities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, and backgrounds to apply. Your voice matters here.
  
  
**To Apply**
Thank you for your interest in joining our team. Please submit your resume along with links to your online portfolio as part of your application (if applicable). Due to the volume of applications we receive, we’re unable to respond to every submission. However, all applications are kept in our talent database and will be considered for future opportunities.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as internal equity, candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role. If your compensation expectations fall outside of this range, we still welcome your application.

title: Associate Creative Director, Performance
description:
**About Sequencing**  
Sequencing is the world’s largest direct-to-consumer whole genome sequencing platform, helping define the future of AI-powered personalized health.

We’re a Series A venture-backed, fully remote company turning clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into meaningful, personalized insights. Through AI and a growing ecosystem of genomic applications, we’re building the trusted home for every genome.

In 2026, GenomeWeb named Sequencing a Best Places to Work winner, highlighting our fully remote culture of autonomy, transparency, and growth. As our COO, Shara Birn, put it: “We hire talented people, give them meaningful responsibility, and trust them to make decisions.”

**About the Role**

Sequencing.com turns clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into a lifelong source of personalized health insights, from everyday wellness questions to serious health decisions. We're rebuilding how that story looks, sounds, and performs, and we need an Associate Creative Director to lead it.

You'll define the new brand and make it earn its keep in paid channels. You'll work side by side with our product designers and agencies so the brand shows up in the product as clearly as it does in an ad. You report to marketing leadership and partner with growth, lifecycle, product marketing, and product design. This is a hands-on seat for someone who wants to ship, not just direct.

**What You'll Own**

* **The rebrand, end to end.** Lead our visual identity, voice, and creative language from concept through rollout across web, product, paid, and lifecycle.
* **Performance creative that works.** Concept, make, and iterate high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, and emerging AI-native channels. You live in the metrics and know why a creative won.
* **Partnership with product designers.** Work shoulder to shoulder with product design so the brand and the experience feel like one thing, from first ad to in-app moments to subscription flows.
* **Stories people trust.** Turn complex genomic data into clear, emotional, scientifically responsible stories that help people understand their genome and act on it.
* **Creative systems that scale.** Build templates, modular assets, and guidelines across acquisition, engagement, retention, and subscription so the team ships faster without losing quality.
* **Fast learning loops.** Run rapid experiments, read the results with growth, and turn what you learn into the next round.
* **A high, consistent bar.** Guide internal teammates, freelancers, and agencies, and stay close to the craft yourself: art direction, writing, design, motion, prototyping, and production.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in creative roles, with 2+ years leading creative or owning a brand at a startup or growth-stage company.
* Proven experience leading or driving a rebrand, ideally at an earlier-stage company where you built the identity and the system, not just applied one.
* A portfolio of performance creative with real results on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or CTV in consumer subscription, DTC, wellness, or tech. You can show the numbers behind the work.
* Hands-on craft in design, video, motion, and creative strategy.
* A track record of working closely with product designers to bring a brand into the product experience.
* Solid digital marketing instincts: funnels, testing, attribution basics, and how creative drives acquisition and retention.
* You use AI tools every day for image, video, motion, copy, and ideation, and can show how they've made your work faster and better.
* Staying power. We value people who commit and grow in a role, so a history of multi-year tenures stands out.
* High ownership and autonomy in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. Experience leading teams, freelancers, and agencies is expected.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in wellness, healthtech, biotech, or another category where trust and science matter.
* Familiarity with design tools your product designers use (Figma) and comfort prototyping in them.
* Experience with lifecycle and subscription creative, such as email, onboarding, and win-back.

**Why Sequencing?**

For decades, the human genome has been one of the richest health information in the world, but most people have never been able to truly understand or use it. We’re changing that.

We're transforming billions of genetic variants and decades of scientific research into technology people can interact with naturally and trust. This isn't another health app. It's a new category that brings together bioinformatics, genetics, and consumer health.

**Your work won’t just help build Sequencing. It will help redefine how people understand themselves through their DNA for decades to come.**

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Paid volunteer time off
* Fully remote work, with equipment provided and internet and cell reimbursements
* Parental bonding leave
* Private, confidential clinical-grade whole genome sequencing for you and your immediate family

*Join us in helping build the interface between humanity and its DNA!*
