title: Creative Director (Organic Social)
description:
Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.

We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.

Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.

**The role**

You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.

Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.

You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.

Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.

We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.

**Requirements**

* **Proven organic social growth |** A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
* **Strategic content leadership |** Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
* **Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting |** Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
* **Content waterfall implementation |** Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
* **Management of both video editors and copywriters |** Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
* **Practical AI experience |** Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
* **Excellent written and spoken English |** The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.

**Preferred experience**

We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.

* **Significant audience growth |** Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
* **Coaching industry experience |** Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
* **YouTube or other long-form audience growth |** A record of building an audience through long-form content.
* **Commercial results |** A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.

**Working arrangement**

* This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
* Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST

**Applications**

* ***Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed.***
* Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within ***one to two weeks*** of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.

*Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!*

title: Creative Director
description:
**ABOUT STORD**
---------------

  

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

  

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

  

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

  

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role
  
  
The Creative Director is the visual and conceptual voice of Stord. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you will set the creative vision for how Stord looks, sounds, and feels across every channel, and lead the studio that brings it to life.
  
  
This role is for a hands-on creative leader who moves comfortably between big ideas and finished work. You have strong opinions about what great creative looks like, a portfolio that proves it, and the leadership skills to inspire a studio team and manage agency and freelance partners. You know that creative and performance work together, and you build campaigns that prove it for DTC founders, ecommerce leaders, and the broader commerce ecosystem.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, and Sales to make sure Stord's creative is consistent, differentiated, and commercially effective at every touchpoint.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Creative Vision & Brand Identity**

* Own Stord's creative vision, visual identity, and brand expression, keeping them consistent and distinctive across all channels and audiences
* Turn Stord's positioning into a clear visual language, voice, and point of view that resonates with mid-market DTC founders and ecommerce operators
* Act as the creative steward of the brand: set standards, educate the organization, and push for quality at every touchpoint
Partner with Product Marketing so creative ladders up to GTM messaging and positioning  

  

**Creative Studio Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop the in-house studio of designers, creatives, and content producers
* Set creative direction and review work across campaigns, sales collateral, web, events, and product marketing assets
* Build efficient creative processes (briefing, intake, review, and approvals) so the studio delivers high-quality work at the pace of a high-growth company
Manage agency and freelance relationships to scale output when needed  

  

**Campaigns & Content Creative**

* Develop big ideas and integrated campaign concepts that bring the brand to life across digital, video, social, events, and owned media
* Direct the creative for thought leadership, video, and editorial content that earns attention and builds brand affinity with DTC founders and ecommerce leaders
* Partner with Demand Generation and Sales to create work that drives pipeline, and use performance data to sharpen it
Make sure all creative reinforces Stord's position as the default operating system for modern commerce  

  

**Brand Experience & Visibility**

* Guide creative for major company moments, including product launches, partnerships, and executive announcements
* Support executive visibility and PR efforts with strong creative storytelling and polished visual assets
Collaborate with Communications and Content on a consistent narrative across press, social, and owned channels  

  

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 10+ years of progressive creative or marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a Creative Director or equivalent creative leadership role, ideally in VC-backed, high-growth B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services
* A strong portfolio showing concept-to-execution work across brand, digital, video, campaigns, and sales or product marketing assets
* Proven experience building or scaling a creative function from an early or underdeveloped state
* Deep fluency across creative direction, brand identity, design, and storytelling, with the judgment to operate at the strategic level without losing touch with craft
* Experience leading and developing in-house creative or studio teams, and the ability to attract, retain, and inspire A-players
* Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and production partners
* Comfort working as a player-coach: you set direction and hold a high bar, and you roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it
Superior storytelling, presentation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to defend creative decisions and represent the brand with conviction  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

title: 3D Miniature Sculptor - Co-Founder & Chief 3D Design Director (CDD)
description:
3D Miniature Sculptor and Business Co-Founder sought for a new Funko-Like luxury collectable range currently in the startup phase

**Important Note on Compensation & Business Stage**

​TESSET is currently in its early incubation phase prior to our Kickstarter launch.  
​This position is a true co-founding partnership, not a salaried or contract role. There is no initial upfront pay or salary prior to crowdfunding. Post-Kickstarter funding will cover full production and distribution. Future executive compensation/dividends will be established as the line scales post-kickstarter.

As such however, this role would suit a candidate currently under other employ, and wished to undertake their work for this business in a part/spare time capacity in the short term

**​About The Business**

​TESSET is an upcoming hybrid product line merging collectible diorama displays (the luxury Gashapon/Funko aesthetic) with a tactical, symbol-based grid tabletop game. The core product features stunning character dioramas housed inside precision-engineered 5cm clear cubes, playing into a competitive 12-round cube-placement strategy.  
​We are currently preparing for our upcoming Kickstarter launch and are seeking our second founding director to take complete ownership of the 3D sculpting pillar—the core visual foundation of our tactile experience.

​**The Role**

​As our Chief 3D Design Director (CDD) and co-founding partner, you will work hand-in-hand with our Founder / CCO (Ryan, UK) to define, formulate, and execute the signature visual identity of the TESSET universe.

​You will take 2D concepts, lore, and character archetypes and translate them into production-ready 3D character assets optimized for large-scale physical production and manufacturing via our Chinese partners.

​**Key Responsibilities**

​**Define the Signature Look**: Formulate and evolve the overarching visual style of TESSET miniatures, establishing a cohesive design language across diverse genres (Sci-Fi, Fantasy, and beyond).

​**3D Character Sculpting**: Design and sculpt dynamic, highly readable character miniatures and environment pieces that pop when viewed through a clear display enclosure.

​**Design for Manufacturing** (DFM): Architect 3D models with strict awareness of physical production constraints, ensuring structural integrity, clean geometry, and minimal friction during mass production.

​**Co-Founder Leadership**: Participate as a core founding director in shaping product expansion sets, campaign milestones, and overall business strategy.

**State-Side Pursuits**: Handle any US activities such as Games Conventions, Partner Meetings etc (Ryan will handle UK/EU Equivalents)

​**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**  
​

**Proven 3D Sculpting Portfolio**: Demonstrated experience in sculpting tabletop miniatures, collectible toys, or character assets (using ZBrush, Blender, or equivalent tools), ideally viewable via ArtStation or MyMiniFactory.

​**Mastery of Small-Scale Anatomy**: Deep understanding of how proportions, silhouettes, and details translate when shrunk down to a 38mm scale.

​**Technical & Manufacturing Awareness**: Understanding of how digital models prepare for resin bureaus or injection molding tolerances/draft angles.

​**Incubation & Entrepreneurial Mindset**: Understanding that this is an early-stage startup; you are looking for long-term brand co-ownership rather than short-term contract work.

​**Collaborative Partner**: A proactive communicator who can build creative direction alongside the CCO.

​**How to Apply**

​If you are an exceptional 3D sculptor who wants to co-found a brand-new tabletop IP from the ground up, we’d love to connect!  
​Please submit your application with:  
​A summary of experience.  
​A link to your portfolio (ArtStation, MyMiniFactory, Behance, etc.) highlighting miniature or character sculpts.  
​A brief note explaining why an early-stage co-founder role appeals to you.  
Any questions you may have at this stage

Pay: $1.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience my 3D modelling software such as Blender, Maya, Zbrush etc?
* Do you have an interest/passion of pop culture media such as video games, tv shows and movies?
* Do you understand this is a founders position and has no day one salary?

title: Creative Director
description:
### **About Us!**

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

### **About Fivestone Studios!**

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

### **Your Mission**

We are looking for an experienced **Creative Director** to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is **hands-on in visual development**, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

**PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Experience Strategy & Design**

* Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.
* Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.
* Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.
* Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

#### **2. Creative & Art Direction**

* Lead the creative direction across projects, defining the visual language, tone and overall approach.
* Develop and present concepts, mood boards, visual references and creative treatments.
* Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.
* Maintain creative consistency and quality across all outputs and disciplines.

#### **3. Creative Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and guide multidisciplinary creative teams, providing clear direction, feedback and creative decisions.
* Work closely with UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists, Creative Technologists, Developers, Animators, 3D Artists, Sound Designers and Producers.
* Encourage collaboration, experimentation and creative problem-solving.
* Ensure all disciplines remain aligned with the agreed creative vision and quality expectations.

#### **4. Technology & Production Collaboration**

* Work closely with Creative Technology and Production teams to ensure concepts are technically and operationally achievable.
* Understand relevant technologies, platforms and physical environments, recognising their opportunities and limitations.
* Balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, scope, budget and schedule.
* Identify potential constraints early and develop creative solutions without compromising the core experience.

#### **5. Creative Oversight & Delivery**

* Maintain creative oversight from concept development through to final delivery.
* Review designs, prototypes and integrated experiences, providing clear and constructive feedback.
* Make timely creative decisions and guide adaptations throughout development and production.
* Identify and resolve creative and experience-related issues, ensuring the final work maintains the quality, coherence and intent of the approved vision.

### **Your Journey**

#### **Must Have**

* **Experience:** developing immersive and interactive experiences across physical and digital environments.

* **Senior Creative Direction Experience:** Extensive experience leading the creative vision and execution of multidisciplinary projects from concept through final delivery.
* **Visual Design & Art Direction:** Strong artistic foundation with the ability to independently establish visual direction and create initial concepts, treatments and style frames.
* **Experience Design:** Proven expertise in shaping engaging user and audience experiences, including experience strategy, UX and interaction design.
* **Content Production:** Demonstrated experience directing sophisticated and technically complex content production across animation, game engines, film, UI and interactive experiences.
* **End-to-End Creative Ownership:** Ability to maintain creative leadership and involvement throughout development and production, ensuring the final experience reflects the approved creative vision.
* **Multidisciplinary Leadership:** Experience guiding creative teams across visual design, motion, animation, content, UX/UI, 3D and creative technology.
* **Creative Technology Understanding:** Strong understanding of technology-driven experiences, including technical possibilities, limitations and integration considerations.
* **Production Awareness:** Ability to balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, production constraints, budgets and schedules.
* **Creative Communication:** Ability to present concepts, communicate artistic direction, provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Background in brand experiences involving immersive, interactive or technology-driven creative work.
* Experience directing creative work across a broad range of content formats and production disciplines.

### **Engagement Opportunity**

The collaboration will begin on a **freelance basis**, with the intention of transitioning into a **full-time role** if there is a strong mutual fit. This is a remote position.

This opportunity is part of Fivestone Studios' long-term creative needs.

Thank you for applying. We’re committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it’s not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

description:

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners' needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we're just getting started.  
  
We're looking for a **Creative Director (Video)** with a strong visual eye and a genuine curiosity about performance creative. You'll work closely with senior creative leads to concept, produce, and iterate video ads across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and CTV — learning and contributing at every stage of the process.

**Hands-on from day one:** This isn't a support role. You'll be concepting, editing, and iterating — using AI tools and your own creative instincts to ship work that performs.

* Concept and produce video creative across paid social, CTV, and emerging channels — working end-to-end from brief to delivery under the guidance of senior creative leads.
* Lead a small and nimble team

* Video editing fluency — you can cut and iterate ads yourself, making them feel polished without heavy direction.
* Performance creative curiosity — you understand (or are actively learning) what makes people stop scrolling: hooks, pacing, CTAs.
* Collaborative and eager mindset — comfortable in fast-paced environments and open to feedback from creative and analytics teams alike.

Jerry's creative team has proven performance chops — and we're ready to level up. This role is an opportunity to grow fast inside a creative engine that blends craft, data, AI, and media strategy. You'll be hands-on from day one, contributing real work that reaches millions of people — and building the skills and portfolio to grow into a senior creative leader.

title: Art Director, Motion and Brand
description:
### **About PrePass**

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

### **About the Role**

The PrePass marketing team is tasked with expanding the PrePass brand. We are energized by the prospect of breaking ground in our field and making a positive impact within the transportation industry. We are looking for an Art Director, Motion and Brand, with strong design, motion, and animation fundamentals and a passion for visual storytelling. This person not only values great craftsmanship but also knows how to turn complex products and ideas into clear, compelling video and animation that share the PrePass story and purpose with our customers.

As the Art Director, Motion and Brand, you'll work with the Senior Art Director, the Director of Marketing Comms, and the larger Marketing team to bring the PrePass brand to life in motion. You'll own video and animated content for performance marketing campaigns, product launches, social, web, and events, with secondary responsibility for digital design across email, social, landing pages, and other channels. This role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables.

### **Essential Responsibilities**

### **Video, Motion, and Animation**

* Conceptualize, storyboard, and produce video and animated content for social, web, email, paid media, webinars, and trade show screens.
* Create product explainers, animated demos, and short-form videos that make complex solutions—toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety—easy to understand.
* Design and animate 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, illustrated animation, and animated data visualizations.
* Edit and finish video from raw footage, including pacing, sound design, music selection, captioning, and color correction.
* Support video shoots, customer testimonials, and event coverage, from shot lists to final edit.
* Build animated brand elements, including logo animations, lower thirds, transitions, and title sequences.
* Develop motion guidelines and reusable templates that keep video and animated content consistent and on-brand.

### **Brand and Creative Support**

* Design marketing assets, including emails, social graphics, landing pages, web banners, and paid ads.
* Create supporting collateral and assets for campaigns and events, such as video thumbnails, ad variations, and presentation graphics.
* Extend the PrePass visual brand identity consistently across video, motion, and digital channels.
* Generate strong conceptual ideas aligned with strategic business goals.
* Clearly articulate creative rationale, concepts, and visual direction to key stakeholders.
* Contribute to all phases of the creative process: research, brainstorming, scripts, storyboards, animatics, style frames, and final production.

### **Collaboration and Tools**

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.
* Use design and production tools such as Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and Asana, along with generative AI tools such as Adobe Firefly and Google Flow, to speed up ideation and production.
* Prepare and optimize files for each channel, including aspect ratios, file sizes, and accessibility standards.

### **Project Execution**

* Manage day-to-day workflow while meeting deadlines across multiple initiatives.
* Support marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, and product launches with motion and design assets.
* Stay current on design, animation, and video trends and bring fresh ideas to the team.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications/Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in design, motion graphics, and animation, gained at an agency, startup, or in-house team.
* A portfolio and reel that showcase polished video editing, motion graphics, animation, and strong design fundamentals—including typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions through a strategic business lens.
* A self-starter who takes full ownership of design projects, both large and small.
* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage timelines across multiple initiatives.
* Based in the United States.

### **Bonus Points For**

* B2B marketing experience, especially translating technical products into clear visual stories.
* Experience with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender), AI-assisted design and video tools, or Lottie/web animation.
* Knowledge of the transportation, logistics, or fleet management industry.
* Availability in Mountain Standard Time or West Coast time zones.
  

  
  
**Benefits**  

### **How We Will Take Care of You**

* Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
* Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
* 401(k) plan with employer match.
* Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
* Tuition Reimbursement Program.
* Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
* Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
* Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
* Community Give-Back initiatives.
* Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

**Join Us**

**At PrePass, our mission drives us.**

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

**Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

description:

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Foundation**

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

**Mission of the Role**

You own the quality bar for everything creative Foundation delivers: written content, design, video, and social and ad creative. You make sure the work clients get is clear, distinctive and built to be found and cited, and that every pod holds it to the same standard. Your job is making the work better and keeping it that way as we grow.

You work across all of our client teams. Each team is led by a Group AEO Marketing Director who owns a book of clients, with an AEO Program Director who runs delivery. Our writers, designers, editors and producers sit in those pods. The Head of Paid Media, the Head of Organic & AI Visibility and their leads set the standard for their channels. You hold the creative bar across all of them.

**Reports to:** Head of Client Services. Direct reports: creative makers not yet placed in pods. Dotted line: the writers, designers, editors and producers in every pod and through our freelance partners.

**What you'll own:**

* The quality gate. You design the creative quality check every piece goes through before it reaches a client: the criteria, the checklists, and who runs it in each pod. Pods run the check day to day. You review a sample of work each week, handle escalations, and personally review high-stakes work, such as a new client’s first deliverables. Work that isn’t ready goes back with feedback the maker can act on.
* The creative standard. You set and document what great looks like at Foundation: guidelines, examples, storytelling and brand frameworks, and the checklists the gate uses.
* Your team. You manage and develop the creative makers who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. When each pod can keep one busy, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.
* Creative hiring. You run the technical skill assessment part of every creative hire and have a veto on creative quality.
* Creative levelling. You define what each level of writer, designer, editor and producer looks like, and give input on their promotions.
* Coaching. You give the people who make the work regular, specific feedback, train them, and close skills gaps across pods.
* AI in the creative workflow. You build and roll out AI tools and workflows that raise quality and speed, and make sure AI-assisted work still meets the bar.
* Partners and freelancers. You make sure third-party creators and editors meet the same standard as our own team.

**What you bring:**

  

* 8+ years in creative leadership for B2B brands, in an agency or in-house, with a portfolio across writing, design and video.
* You've built a quality system before: standards, review gates and feedback loops that held up as volume grew.
* You make the call. You hold the bar under deadline pressure and say no when work isn't ready, without needing someone more senior to back you.
* You've already built things with AI: agents, tools or workflows you use in real creative work, and you can show us how you built them. Hands-on time with tools like Claude, Figma, Higgsfield, HeyGen or ElevenLabs counts. If you haven't built with AI yet, this role isn't the right fit right now.
* Experience teaching others: you've made writers, designers and editors better, including people who don't report to you.
* A clear point of view on what makes content get found and cited by AI assistants, and how that changes the creative brief.

**Position Details:**

Full-time (Monday to Friday, ~40 hours/week), Full Remote

Target Location: Canada, USA

Compensation: Base salary 110k–135k depending on experience and location

Variable compensation: Target 10% of base, tied to KPIs

Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

* Fill in Culture Index survey: https://surveys.cultureindex.com/s/4kEG9f2LvZ/125023
* Apply through the application form

Our newly founded enterprise Marketing team is a transformative organization that puts an in-house Creative Studio arm-in-arm with data, insights, strategy, tech, and governance teams to evolve and elevate how we tell our story and connect with clients. This is a collaborative hub for meaningful and holistic brand-building, bold ideas, and breakthrough campaigns.
  
  
Now, we are adding the role of Creative Director for a new digital banking platform to our team.
  
  
As the organization continues to grow, this key position offers the opportunity to help shape not only a rapidly scaling digital banking brand, but also the future of modern marketing across the enterprise.
  
  
Designed to move nimbly into the future and transcend our footprint while leveraging the Zions Bancorporation foundation of strength and stability.
  
  
This role combines the energy and influence of a high-growth business with the resources, stability, and support of a leading financial institution.
  
  
The platform has successfully launched and is now actively adding new clients offering a unique opportunity for a dynamic, creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization
  
  
The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking.
  
  
Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment.

Brand Building and Stewardship

* Balance innovative approaches with regulatory requirements and financial industry standards.

title: Art Director, Brand & Design
description:
**Job Title:** Art Director, Brand & Design  
**Location:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Director of Brand Marketing  
**Status:** Full-Time  
**Salary Range:** $110,000-$130,000  
**Direct Reports:** Graphic Designers

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded haircare brand dedicated to restoring crowns and confidence. What began as a kitchen remedy has evolved into one of the most celebrated textured-hair care brands in the U.S., loved for our authentic story, transformative results, and community-first approach.

It’s an exciting time to join our team as we grow and build a culture rooted in creativity, collaboration, and care. Together, we’re shaping the next chapter of a brand powered by community and led by purpose to help people everywhere love their hair, love their journey, and love themselves.

**Role Overview**

Bask & Lather is seeking an Art Director, Brand & Design to bring our brand to life across campaigns, digital experiences, product packaging, retail displays, and experiential marketing.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a strong designer who can develop compelling concepts, personally execute key creative, and lead graphic designers to deliver cohesive, commercially effective work. You will translate brand strategy into clear visual direction and help build the systems, standards, and team capabilities needed to support a growing beauty brand.

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Art Direction & Brand Design**

* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for integrated campaigns, product launches, and ongoing brand marketing.
* Translate approved brand strategy into clear art direction, design briefs, and cohesive execution across customer touchpoints.
* Maintain and evolve design standards, templates, and asset libraries within the brand’s established identity.
* Art direct photography, short-form video, creator content, and product demonstrations, including mood boards, composition, styling, and post-production guidance. Ensure clear product education and consistent brand presentation.

**Hands-On Creative Execution**

* Personally design key creative across e-commerce, social, email, paid media, marketplaces, sales materials, and brand campaigns.
* Develop platform-specific creative for TikTok Shop, paid and organic social, creator content, and livestream shopping, adapting storytelling and design to how customers discover and purchase on each channel.
* Translate customer questions, hair concerns, cultural insights, and relevant trends into creative that resonates with our audience and reflects the brand’s voice and standards.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-Commerce, and the Director of Creative Performance to develop and refine creative using performance insights and customer feedback, supporting structured testing and iteration.

**Packaging, Retail & Experiential Design**

* Design packaging, labels, cartons, kits, and other physical brand materials from concept through production-ready artwork.
* Develop retail displays, merchandising assets, signage, and environmental graphics that translate the brand into physical spaces.
* Work with internal partners and external vendors on dielines, specifications, proofs, color, materials, and finishes.
* Ensure artwork includes approved content and completes the required cross-functional reviews before production.

**Team Leadership & Creative Operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop graphic designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback.
* Prioritize projects, balance workloads, and maintain accountability for creative quality and deadlines.
* Review deliverables for brand consistency, accuracy, channel suitability, and production readiness.
* Build scalable workflows that improve turnaround time and reduce unnecessary revisions while maintaining high standards.

**Key KPIs & Success Metrics**

* A cohesive, recognizable brand across digital and physical touchpoints.
* Strong creative delivered accurately and on time.
* A design team with clear direction, useful feedback, and consistent standards.
* Packaging and displays that meet brand, retailer, and production requirements.
* Creative systems that support growth and improve team efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional brand design or creative experience, including experience leading designers and providing art direction.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating consumer brand campaigns, photography and short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand experiences.
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with strong typography, composition, layout, and image-editing skills.
* Practical knowledge of packaging and print production, including dielines, artwork preparation, color management, and proof review.
* Experience designing for e-commerce and digital marketing, with an understanding of how creative supports customer education and conversion.
* Strong judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to move projects forward independently.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to balance personal execution with effective delegation.
* Experience in beauty, haircare, skincare, wellness, or consumer packaged goods is strongly preferred. Experience supporting social commerce, particularly TikTok Shop, is strongly preferred. Ability to direct video and motion work is required; hands-on motion design or video editing is a plus.

**Why Join Bask & Lather Co.?**

* Be part of a passionate, fast-paced team changing the narrative around scalp care
* Play a pivotal role in a high-growth, high-impact brand with national reach
* Directly support strategic initiatives and help shape scalable infrastructure

* Coach and inspire the team to elevate creative thinking, design quality, storytelling, execution standards, and overall creative output.

**Success Measures**

* Improved creative quality, concept development, visual storytelling, and design craftsmanship.
* Consistent adoption and application of Robert Half visual identity standards across major touchpoints.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in creative partnership, quality, and delivery.
* Effective creative support for integrated marketing, content marketing, communications, events, internal initiatives, and digital experiences.
* On-time delivery, improved project cycle time, resource utilization, and production efficiency.
* Successful collaboration with external agencies, freelancers, vendors, and production partners when appropriate.
* Growth in team capability, employee engagement, talent development, and creative maturity.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Advertising, Fine Arts, Marketing, or related discipline required.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in creative, design, advertising, creative services, or brand-related roles.
* 7+ years leading creative teams, agencies, studios, or design organizations.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams responsible for both concept development and production delivery.
* Experience owning or leading visual identity systems, design standards, design systems, or creative guidelines.
* Experience developing integrated creative concepts and production-ready creative across digital, social, web, presentation, event, campaign, video, motion, and print channels.
* Experience partnering with brand, marketing, communications, content, digital, UX, production, agency, and business stakeholders.
* B2B, professional services, consulting, technology, staffing, or related experience preferred.

**Competencies / Abilities**

* Creative direction.
* Creative concept development.
* Visual identity system ownership.
* Design systems leadership.
* Art direction and visual storytelling.
* Creative services production leadership.
* Integrated campaign concepting and execution.
* Creative operations and resource management.
* Agency, freelance, vendor, and production partner management.
* Team leadership, coaching, and talent development.
* Creative innovation, AI-enabled creativity, and emerging creative technologies.
* Strategic thinking, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Executive presence and strong presentation skills.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
* Ability to influence without authority in a matrixed environment.
* Ability to articulate and defend creative direction, design rationale, and production recommendations.
* Ability to provide constructive creative feedback and lead productive critique processes.
* Strong relationship building across marketing, communications, creative, digital, agency, vendor, and business stakeholders.

**Minimum Required Technical Skills**

* Expert knowledge of modern design tools and creative platforms.

title: Associate Creative Director
description:
World Vision is hiring an Associate Creative Director to serve in the Marketing Division.
  
  
AT A GLANCE
  
**Role:** Associate Creative Director
  
**Reports to:** Senior Creative Director
  
**Location:** Remote
  
**Required Experience:** In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required.
  
**Preferred Experience:** Prior people-management experience is preferred. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A for any employer.
  
**Travel:** Up to 10% of the time.
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
THE JOB
  
Lead creative development, storytelling, and brand expression within World Vision’s internal advertising agency. Partner with senior leadership to translate fundraising and audience strategies into integrated, multichannel campaigns, with an emphasis on writing and messaging. Guide assigned team members, set priorities, and oversee quality and delivery to strengthen brand awareness and produce measurable results. Carry out World Vision’s Christian mission, vision, and strategies, witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
* Lead assigned brand and fundraising campaigns from strategic brief through final delivery, translating audience insight and organizational objectives into integrated creative concepts, messaging, and multichannel experiences.
* Serve as the lead creative and conceptual partner for assigned work, developing campaign narratives, concepts, messaging frameworks, calls to action, and creative solutions across direct response, digital, social, video, experiential, print, email, web, and emerging platforms.
* Establish project-level creative direction, goals, priorities, and quality expectations for assigned writers, designers, freelance partners, and cross-disciplinary teams; monitor progress and resolve difficult but typically non-complex execution, resource, and stakeholder issues.
* Review work in progress and final deliverables for strategic alignment, brand voice, creative quality, accuracy, accessibility, channel requirements, budget, and timelines; provide clear, actionable feedback and approve work within delegated authority.
* Partner with peers, the Senior Creative Director, and cross-functional partners to clarify briefs, align expectations, allocate resources, and deliver cohesive creative solutions.
* Present creative concepts and rationale to clients and senior stakeholders, synthesize feedback, and guide the team toward effective solutions.
* Supervise assigned professional employees and creative personnel, including setting goals and objectives, assigning work, coaching performance, supporting development, and contributing to talent decisions.
* Support a client-centric in-house agency model through strong service standards, collaboration, processes, and consistent policies.
* Use performance data, audience feedback, testing results, and emerging tools to improve work.
* Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS
  

* Creative thinking, storytelling, concept development, and strong oral and written communication, including fluent English and persuasive messaging that motivates donors and prospects.
* Advanced marketing and branding knowledge and graphic design fundamentals, supported by fundraising knowledge and an understanding of global events and World Vision’s mission and priorities.
* Strategic orientation and planning: Translating organizational goals into creative strategies and practical short- and long-range plans across work units.
* Implementation and project management: build production plans, identify resources, balance competing priorities, and manage milestones, costs, and delivery.
* Team building, people management, collaboration, and relationship building set clear expectations, develop team members, and build strong internal and external partnerships.
* Customer-focused solution design, initiative, adaptability, and quality orientation: respond to changing needs, solve problems proactively, and improve processes and creative work.

REQUIREMENTS
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (8 years). In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required. Prior people-management experience is preferred. A portfolio demonstrating strong creative thinking, concept development, and campaign effectiveness is required. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
  
SALARY & BENEFITS
  
**WVUS Pay Grade Level:** 228
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
The posted hiring salary range reflects pay for U.S. locations and is determined using market data and internal compensation guidelines. Actual compensation may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, and applicable laws. For information about World Vision U.S' comprehensive benefits package, please visit this link.
  
  
ABOUT WORLD VISION
  
We're a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.
  
  
**L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:**  
The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.
  
  

* Love: How we show up every day, every interaction. Loving others the way Jesus loves—with humility, care, and grace-filled truth. We build trust. We model life with God. And we create environments where people feel seen, valued, and supported, because we see the image of our God in each of them.
* Ignite: How we unlock and catalyze. To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.
* Fulfill: How We Deliver. To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
* Envision: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’. To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
  
Due to the high volume of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for an initial phone conversation with a recruiter. Please include a link to a creative portfolio or website. We also encourage you to submit a PDF resume and a cover letter. Our goal is to fill this vacancy with the right person in the shortest amount of time.

description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**Location:**
New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
  
  
**About The Team**
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the
**Design Director**
on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

title: Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

**The role**
------------

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

**The day-to-day**
------------------

* Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
* Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
* Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
* Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
* Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.

title: Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe
description:
**About the Role**

Teach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships. As a Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe, you will steward Teach For All's engagement with a group of partner organizations in the Europe region, working to build and deepen relationships and collaboration in pursuing educational equity in Europe. In this role you will act as a strategic advisor to partner organizations, diagnosing needs and opportunities, consulting on strategic challenges, and mobilizing network resources to drive collective impact

In this position, you will also play a critical role in strengthening partner organizations'public sector partnerships through targeted support around institutional relations strategy development and execution in key countries in Europe. You will work closely with global team members to build more active partner connections and collaboration with their governments (Ministries of Education at national, regional or local levels; regional and local authorities; Universities and research institutions), by developing specific partner support initiatives, contributing to Erasmus+ projects, and designing learning experiences and ad-hoc resources when needed. The ideal candidate for this position will have a proven ability to work effectively across diverse contexts and cultures, navigating ambiguity with ease, and will have experience making sound strategic decisions that drive impact in complex and changing environments.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for an individual with superior leadership, strategic, interpersonal, and programmatic skills to increase the impact of our mission and shape the education landscape in the region. The strongest candidates will have a proven ability to set a clear vision, build culture and relationships, influence outcomes through others, and make strategic decisions that drive meaningful impact. A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director- Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

**Outcomes**

* Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All's vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
* Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.
* There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:

* Our network is expanding in the region.
* Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
* Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
* Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
* Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
* Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities:**

Partner Support (40%)

* As a "portfolio lead," serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes.
* Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director's portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All.
* Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All's shared global vision and priorities.

Public Sector Support (50 %)

* Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
* Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region.
* Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
* Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values.
* Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes.
* Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally.
* Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

* Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
* Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
* Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
* Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
* Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
* Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
* Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

**Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences**

* Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
* Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
* Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
* Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
* Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

**What Teach For All Offers:**

* Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization's progress
* Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
* Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
* Generous time off and flexible work arrangements

* And much more!

**Application Instructions**

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

**Compensation**

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

**Travel and Hours**

All work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

**About Teach For All**

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations' under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All's global organization works to increase the network's impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

description:

title: Lead Yaw Systems Mechanical Engineer

Drive efforts to introduce advanced technology, materials, manufacturing methods, new design tools/methods to advance the strategic position of yaw subsystem components  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Significant experience in mechanical analysis and design experience in industry
* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing

* Excellent communication, project management, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across cultural boundaries
* Ability to work under pressure and challenging conditions
* Established problem solving process knowledge and execution
* Strong desire and ability to drive improvement and change

description:
Barcelona, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1578075

  

**Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships.**

IQVIA is changing an entire industry through inspired innovation. Our people make the difference. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we look for talented people and give them meaningful work to do. Join IQVIA and help us drive healthcare forward.
