title: Head of Talent Acquisition (Remote)
description:
**Unstoppable starts with people.** The future of payments is being built today, and at **Paymentology**, we are looking for people who want to help shape it. We power card issuing for leading banks, fintechs and digital brands across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we are looking for curious, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex challenges, embrace innovation and want to make a tangible impact at global scale.

**Head of Talent Acquisition**
==============================

We’re looking for a **Head of Talent Acquisition** to lead and shape our global Talent Acquisition function, ensuring Paymentology attracts, assesses and secures the exceptional talent needed to deliver our business strategy.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll define our global Talent Acquisition strategy, establish high hiring standards and lead a team of three TA Partners and a TA Operations role to deliver an effective, consistent and high-performing recruitment function.

This is a strategic leadership role for someone who combines commercial judgement, deep recruitment expertise and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders. You’ll play a critical role in translating business and workforce priorities into effective hiring strategies, strengthening hiring decisions and continuously evolving an effective, scalable and data-driven TA function that supports our global growth.

**Location:** This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Poland, Italy, Slovenia, Serbia, Czech Republic, Portugal, Croatia or Spain.

**Application deadline:** 18 November 2026.

**What you get to do:**
-----------------------

### **Talent Acquisition Strategy & Hiring Priorities**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning recruitment priorities with business objectives, approved workforce plans and future capability needs.
* Partner with the Executive Team, functional leaders and Finance to understand workforce requirements, challenge assumptions and recommend hiring priorities based on business impact, affordability, market conditions and recruitment capacity.
* Anticipate talent-market challenges and hiring risks, providing strategic insights and recommendations that support informed workforce and hiring decisions.
* Continuously evolve the TA operating model to support changing business needs, ensuring the function remains scalable, efficient and commercially focused.

### **Hiring Excellence & Talent Standards**

* Define and maintain high hiring standards, ensuring recruitment decisions are structured, evidence-based and aligned with Paymentology’s talent philosophy.
* Set clear expectations for role definition, assessment quality and hiring decisions, ensuring TA Partners effectively challenge requirements and uphold consistent hiring standards.
* Drive a culture of hiring excellence through effective interview practices, strong hiring-manager capability, timely decision-making and a positive candidate experience.

### **Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a global Talent Acquisition team comprising three TA Partners and a TA Operations role, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Empower TA Partners to own recruitment within their functions, strengthening their ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex hiring challenges and make decisions independently.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight to TA Operations, ensuring systems, processes, governance and reporting enable effective recruitment delivery.

### **Stakeholder Partnership & Strategic Influence**

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the Chief People Officer and Executive Team, providing insights on hiring priorities, talent-market dynamics and critical capability needs.
* Influence and challenge senior stakeholders, resolve competing hiring priorities across functions and provide leadership on selected executive and business-critical appointments.

### **Recruitment Operations, Technology & Analytics**

* Oversee the effectiveness of recruitment processes, systems and governance, ensuring consistent, compliant and scalable hiring practices across the organisation.
* Champion the adoption of modern recruitment technology, AI and automation to improve hiring quality, operational efficiency and candidate experience.
* Define and monitor recruitment performance metrics, leveraging data and market intelligence to identify improvement opportunities and inform strategic decisions.

### **Talent Attraction**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global talent attraction strategy, strengthening our ability to engage and attract high-calibre talent in priority markets.
* Partner with People and Marketing to strengthen Paymentology’s positioning in priority talent markets and support proactive talent attraction initiatives and partnerships.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* Extensive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 5 years in leadership roles with responsibility for TA strategy, team performance and recruitment effectiveness.
* Experience operating in a globally distributed organisation, ideally within SaaS, technology infrastructure or a similarly complex environment.
* Proven ability to define and execute a global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning hiring priorities and recruitment capabilities with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Strong commercial acumen and strategic judgement, with the ability to balance business priorities, hiring demand, recruitment capacity, budget considerations and talent-market realities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise and constructively challenge C-suite executives and senior business leaders.
* Deep recruitment expertise, with a proven ability to establish and uphold high hiring standards, drive structured and evidence-based assessment, and improve the quality of hiring decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing Talent Acquisition teams, building accountability, empowering others and developing their capability to operate as strategic business partners.
* Strong analytical capabilities, using recruitment data, performance metrics and talent-market intelligence to inform decisions, identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience designing and evolving scalable recruitment operating models, processes and governance, with the ability to lead change and drive adoption across the organisation.
* Strong understanding of modern recruitment technology, ATS platforms, automation and AI, with the ability to leverage these to improve hiring quality, efficiency and candidate experience. Experience with Ashby is a strong advantage.

We’re a team that cares deeply about the quality of our work, supports each other and is always looking for ways to improve. You’ll be joining a group of people who enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas and making things better, with plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

  

### **What You Will Own:**

* Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.
* Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.
* The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.
* Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.
* Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.
* Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.
* Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.
* Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by.

### **What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:**

* High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve.
* Portable, cloud-agnostic deployments: one deployment model that runs the Platform on AWS, on at least one other cloud, and on customer infrastructure — defined as code and delivered through GitOps.
* AI agents running operations: agents that handle routine operational work — triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting — with measurable reductions in manual effort and a smaller tool footprint.
* Platform foundations for the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and integration APIs: scalable, observable infrastructure that product teams build on.
* Compliance automation and audit readiness: evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR collected automatically from the platform rather than assembled by hand before each audit.

### **We expect this leader to treat AI as part of the platform. That means you will:**

* Design and run AI agents that operate infrastructure under clear guardrails — human approval for high-risk changes, and full audit trails.
* Review our current tooling and retire tools that AI agents or simpler automation can replace, with a cost and risk case for each change.
* Use AI coding and operations assistants in your own daily work, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Build the compute, data, and access patterns that let AI and ML workloads run reliably in every environment we support.

### **What You Bring:**

* 10+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years managing engineers — with experience building or scaling a team, not only running an established one.
* AI-first mindset, making extensive use of this technology for accelerating developments.
* A track record of shipping on-premises or self-hosted software that customers install and run in their own environments.
* Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or similar tooling.
* Strong AWS experience, and the judgment to design for portability rather than lock-in to a single cloud.
* Hands-on experience operating systems under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR controls, including data-residency requirements.
* Experience managing cloud costs and making cost trade-offs explicit to engineering and business leaders.
* Clear written communication, suited to a fully remote team across US and EU time zones.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience running infrastructure for data platforms, data catalogs, or graph databases.
* Production experience on Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS.
* Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network customer deployments.
* Experience building infrastructure for AI and ML workloads, including model serving and vector or graph data stores.
* Observability with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling, from instrumentation through alerting.
* Privileged access management with StrongDM or a comparable tool.

### **What We Value:**

We value autonomy over process, outcomes over activity, and builders over theorists. This role suits someone who thrives when handed a hard problem, a team to build, and the space to figure it out — and who uses every tool available, including AI, to multiply the team's impact.

### **How You Will Work:**

You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with product engineering, security, customer success, and support. The role is fully remote from the US, UK, Spain, France or Germany, with at least four hours a day of overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Expect occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings.

### **What We Offer:**

* The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
* Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

**Why Join Us?** At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

**Interested?** We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

### **Success Measures**

**First 30 Days**

* BU Procurement

Proven engineering depth, procurement process knowledge, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to quickly learn enterprise systems are essential. Validate candidates through one architecture walkthrough and one practical automation or code review.

title: Direct Response Supplement Copywriter (with AI Avatars)
description:
**AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter**
------------------------------------

Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting

**About Us**
------------

Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.

We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.

We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.

Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.

Company: Impact Clients  
Website: https://go.impactclients.co/ Language: English  
Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)  
Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred  
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote  
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response  
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month

**Our Business Model**
----------------------

We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.

Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.

Here's how the business works:

* Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
* Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
* Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
* Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
* Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.

Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.

You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.

**Example Accounts & Creative References**
------------------------------------------

Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.

Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:

* Nutrition Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/nutrition.is.greatness/reels/
* Wellness Everyday Health: https://www.instagram.com/wellnesseverydayhealth/reels/
* Homestead Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/homestead.wellness.daily/reels/

* Health Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/health.is.greatness/reels/
* Travis on Wellness: https://www.instagram.com/travisonwellness/reels/

These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.

Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.

We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
* Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
* Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
* Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
* Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
* Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
* Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
* Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
* Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
* Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
* Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
* Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
* Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
* Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
* Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
* Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
* Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
* Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
* Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
* Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

**Nice To Haves**
-----------------

* Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
* Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
* Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
* Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
* Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
* Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
* Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
* Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
* Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.

We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.

Success in this position means:

* Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
* Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
* Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
* Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
* Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
* Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.

Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.

You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.

**Our Core Values**
-------------------

We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.

Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.

Our three core values define how we work:

1. Client Success = Company Success

Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.

Client success always comes first.

2. 1% Better Every Day

We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.

Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.

We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.

3. FIO — Figure It Out

We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.
* Build and maintain automations, Make scenarios and AI agents (for example Claude skills and MCP connections, ClickUp agents and AI assistants) that handle repetitive coordination: assignment checks, delivery QA, content safety and duration checks, reporting, onboarding messages and sample tracking.
* Test new AI and agentic tools for operations and creative production, and recommend what to adopt, with clear costs, risks and expected time saved.
* Keep a registry of every running automation and agent, with its purpose, owner and schedule. Make sure each one is monitored, documented and that failures surface quickly.
* Train the team to run and trust these workflows, so they keep working without depending on the person who built them.

ClickUp workspace

* Own the marketing ClickUp workspace: structure, lists, statuses, templates, dashboards, permissions, forms and native automations. Serve as the escalation point for ClickUp issues.
* Keep the workspace practical, accurate and usable as team needs change, with consistent processes across internal teams and external partners.
* Make sure tasks hold the information needed for execution, reporting and accountability.

Notion and operational documentation

* Own the architecture and maintenance of the marketing Notion workspace, including operational databases such as the ads delivery and creator sample trackers.
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.
* Update documentation whenever workflows change, so essential knowledge is easy to find and does not depend on any one person.

Reporting and operational performance

* Own marketing operations reporting and the accuracy of the trackers behind it.
* Keep visibility into assignments, production, delivery, backlog, capacity, onboarding and operational risks. Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.
* Define and maintain operational KPIs and their calculations with the relevant stakeholders, such as creative lead time and on-time delivery. Flag missing or inconsistent data before using it to assess performance.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement improvements that speed up execution, reduce avoidable revisions and improve resource use.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own the operational administration of the marketing tool stack (including Higgsfield, HeyGen, Claude, Make, Tagbox and other creative and AI tools): access, onboarding, offboarding, usage tracking and vendor coordination.
* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.
* Review software needs with team leads, coordinate renewals and resolve access or usage issues. Cut unnecessary costs and identify tools that make production faster.
* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

* Own the administration and documentation of creative rewards programs.
* Maintain eligibility rules, performance trackers, milestone records and calculation procedures. Validate the monthly close with the relevant performance and finance owners before rewards are approved for payment.
* Resolve questions on naming, attribution, iterations and eligibility consistently. Escalate exceptions and proposed rule changes to leadership.

Hiring, onboarding and offboarding coordination

* Partner with the Head of People and functional leads to identify hiring needs based on capacity, workload and performance.
* Keep visibility into open roles, expected start dates, onboardings, exits and resource gaps, and share a regular hiring operations recap.
* Coordinate skills-test logistics for creative candidates with the reviewing leads.
* Prepare new joiners operationally: workspace access, onboarding checklists and ClickUp templates, pod and channel assignments, welcome messages and training resources.
* Oversee the marketing side of offboarding so access is removed across every tool and shared account, and responsibilities and files are handed over properly.
* People owns recruitment and formal HR processes. You own the operational readiness and integration of marketing hires.

Admin team management

* Lead the marketing operations admins. Set weekly priorities, clarify ownership and review the accuracy and completeness of assignment, delivery, reporting and access-management work.
* Keep dependable daily coverage so recurring work continues through absences and staffing changes. Own escalations and fix the process when the same issue comes back.

Leadership support and continuous improvement

* Give the CEO a clear view of operational health, risks, capacity and decisions required.
* Support planning for new products, brands, teams, partners and growth initiatives. Assess operational requirements, resource implications and execution risks before rollout.
* Keep visibility into vendor costs, rewards liabilities and resource allocation, and provide accurate operational inputs for budget and profitability decisions.
* Proactively spot broken or missing processes, and take approved improvements from diagnosis through implementation, documentation and team adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Marketing priorities have clear owners and realistic deadlines. Teams know what to work on, approved assets move steadily toward launch and blockers surface early.
* Every asset that reaches media buying has passed its quality, safety and duration checks, and delivery records match reality.
* Manual coordination keeps shrinking as reliable workflows, automations and AI agents take it over, and the team knows how to run them.
* Creator, affiliate and social media programs run on clear processes, with samples, content, rights and results tracked end to end.
* ClickUp, Notion, automations and trackers stay accurate and useful. Leadership can see production status, capacity and risks without chasing updates.
* New hires join prepared pods with the right access and onboarding, and leavers are offboarded cleanly. External partners follow clear delivery processes.
* Tool usage, Higgsfield credits, costs and rewards are tracked reliably and reconcile to source.
* After the handover, the function runs independently, with you as the central owner of daily coordination, systems and operational improvement.

  
**Requirements**

What we're looking for

* Experience owning marketing operations, creative operations or project operations in a DTC e-commerce business or performance marketing agency.
* Strong hands-on ClickUp skills, including workspace design, dashboards, templates and automations, and confidence building and maintaining Notion documentation.
* A clear understanding of creative production workflows, paid media delivery, retention operations and cross-functional campaign execution.
* Experience coordinating distributed, multi-time-zone teams, managing competing deadlines and holding internal teams and external partners accountable.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, operational reporting, software costs and performance data, and the ability to spot unreliable data and fix the tracking behind it.
* A track record of building workflows and integrating AI into operations (for example Make, Zapier, Claude, ClickUp AI or custom agents), from first idea to a process the team uses every day.
* Experience overseeing creator, affiliate or social media programs, or working closely with the teams that run them.
* Clear written communication, sound judgment and the confidence to make routine operational decisions on your own.

Nice to have

* Experience with AI creative tools such as Higgsfield or HeyGen, and with managing credit-based tool budgets.
* Hands-on experience running creator, UGC or affiliate programs, including sample logistics and commission tracking.
* Experience operating through BFCM or other high-volume launch periods.

Above all, we need someone who takes full ownership, follows through and builds systems the team can rely on.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive monthly rate based on experience and ability to move fast
* Fully remote — no fixed location, flexible setup
* Access to real performance data and learning from how the creative system actually works at scale
* Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production and operations infrastructure

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
**About the Team**

The project focuses on a major redesign, improving the application architecture, delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, and developing new business features to further enhance the product.

In this role, you’ll work on application architecture, platform-level solutions, and key user-facing features. You’ll have the opportunity to influence the technical direction of our iOS application, improve existing solutions, and contribute directly to its product evolution.

Our team includes 3 iOS Developers, 3 QA Engineers, and a Team Leader.

We follow Agile and Scrum methodologies with 2-week sprints and daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST.

We also follow an AI-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including code development, code reviews, debugging, and problem-solving.

### **Project Description**

* Programming Language: All code is written exclusively in Swift. There are only a few classes written in Objective-C, which are necessary for interoperability with C++ code.

* User Interface: Legacy code uses Storyboards and NIB files, while new code is written programmatically. One of the current priorities is redesigning the application and delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families.

* Data Storage: CoreData is used for data management. Experience with multithreading is required.

* Unit Tests: The Nimble framework is used for unit testing.

* UI Tests: Cucumber is used for user interface testing. The team is also transitioning towards native Swift-based test automation.

* Compatibility: The minimum supported iOS version is 15.

* Build System: Tuist is used for dependency management and project building.

* C++ Integration: Occasionally, reading and integrating C++ code is required.

* Reactive Programming: RxSwift is actively used in the project.

* Architecture: New code follows the MVVM architectural pattern with the use of Coordinators.

* Modularity: The project uses a multi-module architecture with more than 40 modules, and the number of modules is constantly increasing.

* Legacy Code: The project includes legacy code that needs to be maintained and improved. It is important to understand existing implementations, refactor them when necessary, and introduce changes safely without disrupting existing functionality.

* AI Integration: AI tools are actively integrated into everyday development workflows, supporting code development, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.

### **Tasks**

* Develop and maintain our iOS application, including implementing new business features and improving existing functionality.
* Contribute to the redesign and modernization of the iOS product, including adaptive UI implementation across different screen sizes and device families.
* Design and improve application architecture and platform-level solutions within a multi-module environment.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, handle network requests, and implement WebSocket and other socket-based connections.
* Work with CoreData, multithreading, and asynchronous operations to ensure application performance and stability.
* Maintain, refactor, and improve legacy code while ensuring compatibility with existing functionality.
* Develop and maintain unit and UI tests to ensure application quality and reliability.
* Troubleshoot and debug technical issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement appropriate solutions.
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with designers, product managers, QA Engineers, and other developers throughout the development lifecycle.
* Actively use AI tools to improve development workflows, code quality, and engineering efficiency.

### **Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of Swift and experience writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Strong understanding of the iOS SDK, including UIKit, CoreData, and CoreAnimation.
* Experience with Auto Layout and Xcode Interface Builder.
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs, working with network requests, handling server responses, and processing JSON data.
* Experience working with WebSocket and other socket protocols, including establishing and maintaining persistent connections with a server.
* Experience maintaining, refactoring, and improving legacy code without disrupting existing functionality.
* Experience writing unit and UI tests. Knowledge of testing tools and frameworks such as XCTest and Quick/Nimble.
* Deep understanding of OOP principles and their practical application in iOS development.
* Experience applying architectural and design patterns such as MVC, MVVM, VIPER, etc.
* Experience working with modular architectures and multi-module iOS projects.
* Strong knowledge of reactive programming and practical experience with RxSwift.
* Understanding of multithreading and asynchronous programming in iOS.
* Experience working with third-party libraries and dependencies.
* Fluent in Russian and at least B1 level of English.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience developing fintech or trading applications, or working on other high-load products with a large user base.
* Basic understanding of C++ and experience integrating Swift with C++ code.

### **We offer**

* Full-time remote work (service provider contract).
* Competitive compensation (EUR).
* 20 paid days off annually.
* Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.).
* Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency.

* Positive and friendly atmosphere.
* Opportunity to contribute creative ideas and directly influence the product’s architecture and technical direction.

With a team of 500+ creative and tech-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark.

**Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together!**

title: Market Development Manager — EMEA
description:
#### **About the Role:**

Hearing care is consolidating. Regional chains are becoming national ones, national ones are going multi-country, and most of them are still running on software that cannot take them there. Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide — no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.

**Your mandate:**

* **Market selection:** build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.
* **Market entry:** create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.
* **Demand:** turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.

#### **What You Will Do:**

* Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.
* EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.
* Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.
* Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.
* Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.
* Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.
* Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.
* Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.
* Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.
* Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.
* Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.
* A self-directed mindset: you will be creating this territory, not inheriting it.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Remote-first and async-friendly with a flat organizational structure.
* A modern IT environment: leading AI tools, HubSpot CRM and the means to automate your go-to-market.
* A real career path and leadership track, with development and certification support.
* A global, diverse team across 30+ nationalities.
* A product held to ISO 13485 and EU MDR, and a mission that matters: do this well and more people hear better, sooner.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

We look forward to your application! (***please submit your CV in English and a few lines on why this role interests you***)

Your mission will be to **design, build, and oversee security solutions from an architectural perspective**, defining what “secure” means for new systems and use cases before they reach production.

You will play a key role in protecting the organization’s technology infrastructure, working across **networks, cloud, systems, applications, and artificial intelligence**. You will take part in strategic projects, collaborate with internal teams and specialized vendors, and maintain a deep technical understanding of the solutions implemented.

**What you will do:**

* **Security Architecture:** define reference architectures and security requirements for networks, cloud, systems, and applications, applying **Security by Design and Zero Trust** principles.
* **AI Security:** design secure patterns for **copilots, RAG solutions, AI agents, and MCP servers**, addressing risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized access, and excessive agent permissions.
* **Identity & Access:** design and integrate **IAM and CIAM** solutions, including non-human identities, service accounts, and identities associated with AI agents.
* **Secure Software Development Lifecycle:** integrate security throughout the entire development lifecycle, adapting **S-SDLC** to environments where part of the code may be AI-generated or AI-assisted.
* **Security Solution Selection & Implementation:** identify needs, evaluate security products and tools, coordinate their implementation, and ensure a smooth handover to operations teams.
* **Technical Coordination:** work with external vendors and internal teams, ensuring the integration, performance, and security of solutions across the organization’s technology ecosystem.
* **Cybersecurity Innovation:** analyze emerging trends and propose **AI-driven security initiatives** that help increase the organization’s security maturity.

  
**Requirements**  

* **At least 4 years of experience in Security Architecture**, participating in the design and implementation of security solutions within complex technology environments.
* Experience with **S-SDLC, IAM, and the selection, implementation, or integration of security tools**.
* A strong technical foundation in **network security, cloud, secure development, authentication protocols, and cryptography**.
* Ability to **identify and assess security risks**, translate them into technical requirements, and propose appropriate mitigation measures.
* Understanding of the main risks associated with **generative and agentic AI**, particularly in relation to identity, data, permissions, applications, and models.
* **High level of Spanish and English**.
* Availability to work in a hybrid model **in Arrasate-Mondragón**.

**Nice to have:**

* **University degree in Engineering or a STEM-related field**.
* Experience in the **financial sector or regulated environments**, particularly with frameworks such as **DORA or NIS2**.
* Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem: **Microsoft Entra ID, Defender, Purview, Sentinel, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft 365 Copilot**.
* Experience in Generative AI security: **guardrails, AI gateways, AISPM, DSPM, and securing RAG applications and AI agents**.
* Knowledge of **threat modeling**, using methodologies or frameworks such as **STRIDE or MITRE ATLAS**.
* Experience with **DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, and security control automation**.
* Certifications such as **CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, CIAM, AZ-500, SC-100, ISACA AAISM, IAPP AIGP, or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer**.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary determined by the market and your experience

* Flexible schedule 35 Hours / Week
* Fully remote work (optional)
* Flexible compensation (restaurant, transport, and childcare) ✌
* Fully free health insurance, with a co-payment for dental services
* Individual budget for training or equipment and free Microsoft certifications
* English lessons
* Birthday day off
* Monthly bonus for electricity and Internet expenses at home
* Discount on gym plan and sports activities
* Plain Camp (annual team-building event)
* Extra perks: events attendance and speakers, welcome pack, baby basket, Christmas basket, discount portal for employees ➕ The pleasure of always working with the latest technological tools!

**Will you let us know you better?**

The selection process: Simple, just 3 steps.

* Phone screen
* 2 interviews with the team

**What is Plain Concepts?**

Plain Concepts is a global company of over 500 people passionate about technology and innovation. Since our founding, we have grown through technical proficiency and confidence in ideas that others might consider risky, creating custom solutions for our clients. With offices in more than 6 countries, our mission is to continue to drive cuttingedge projects around the world.

We are highly committed to technical excellence. We are known for developing highly customized projects, offering specialized technical consultancy and training.

Thanks to the great work of our technicians, we have been recognized for our ability to lead innovative projects that generate value, from artificial intelligence to blockchain, driving solutions that help companies optimize their performance.

**What we do at Plain Concepts?**

We pride ourselves on being a 100% technical team, dedicated to crafting custom projects from scratch, offering expert technical consultancy, and providing top-tier training.

* Our approach goes beyond traditional outsourcing; we focus on creating value together with our clients.
* Our teams are diverse and multidisciplinary, operating in a flat, collaborative structure.
* We live and breathe AGILE principles, ensuring flexibility and efficiency in everything we do.
* Knowledge-sharing is at our core: from supporting each other internally to contributing to the broader tech community through conferences, events, and talks.
* Innovation drives us — even the boldest ideas are welcome here.

**Want to learn more?**

Check out our website! ➡ https://www.plainconcepts.com/

description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Middle UI/UX Designer to join our design team. In this role, you will create intuitive, user-centered, and visually compelling experiences for AI-driven platforms, mobile apps, and web applications. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to develop solutions that balance user needs and business goals. You will also get to design for products across all sorts of industries and platforms, making this an exciting place to exercise your design muscles.

This role requires a high level of creativity, collaboration, and attention to detail. The ideal candidate has a strong background in UI/UX design, an eye for aesthetics, and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Contribute to the design process from concept to implementation for individual clients and NineTwoThree projects following industry best practices and company procedures.
* Deliver well-structured Figma boards with components, symbols and brand styles that remain consistent throughout the design process and have a single source of truth for all elements that update entire systems.
* Develop wireframes, interactions, and high-fidelity UI designs using Figma.
* Create prototypes when delivering design ideas to illustrate different design solutions and test hypotheses.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into user-friendly designs.
* Prepare high-quality, developer-ready designs covering most edge cases and ensure smooth handoff to engineering teams, providing specs, assets, and documentation as needed.
* Explore ways to optimize the design process, including using AI tools, and share findings with the team
* Present and explain design ideas to teammates and clients, grounding your rationale in user needs, business goals, and established design principles.
* Participate Actively in multiple projects simultaneously.
* Stay updated with UI/UX standards and guidelines to ensure our applications are intuitive and follow familiar patterns.

  
**Requirements**

Requirements

* At least 3 years as a UI/UX Designer, with a portfolio that shows user flows, usability and visual design for established brands.
* Experience designing for AI-driven applications.
* Experience designing responsive mobile and web apps, and working knowledge of Material Design and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.
* Strong visual fundamentals: typography, composition, layout, grids and colour, with close attention to detail.
* Advanced Figma: team libraries, auto layout, component properties and prototyping.
* Experience contributing to a shared design system and giving and receiving design feedback.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced agile environment with clear processes, tight deadlines and several projects at once.
* Clear written and spoken communication, working remotely and asynchronously across departments.
* Upper-Intermediate English (B2) or higher.  
    
  Will be an advantage:
* + Hands-on use of AI tools, such as Claude, Cursor or Codex, in the design workflow.
  + Experience building working prototypes in code with AI tools such as Claude or Cursor (React, Next.js, Tailwind).
  + Interaction design experience: states, transitions between steps, feedback and edge cases.

You’ll Thrive If You:

* + Enjoy designing non-trivial web apps

  + Can work independently through the full design cycle
  + Communicate clearly in writing and through presentations

You Might Struggle If You:

* + Take weeks to deliver results
  + Are not used to feedback from Product Managers, Engineers and QAs
  + Rely solely on visual aesthetics or general design trends

Hiring process:

title: Senior Manager Pricing
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ABOUT THE ROLE AND THE TEAM**

You will lead pricing for the **Airports & Borders Business Unit**, aiming to grow revenue, protect margin and price consistently across all GEOs. You will be the BU's main pricing partner: you'll shape investment cases, support deal teams in building accurate, well-governed quotes, and make the CPQ-based pricing operating model the standard way of working across the company. You will also manage a team of pricing professionals.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Pricing strategy and governance**

* Set and maintain the BU's pricing strategy: segmentation, floor and ceiling prices, discounting rules and pricing authority levels.
* Make sure the BU's price books and quoting tools are accurate and up to date, and own the communication of price book changes, pricing guidelines and bid strategy to GEOs and Sales.
* Enforce discount and pricing guardrails.

**Deal support and approval**

* Work with Sales, Solution Design, Commercial Management to build quotes that are accurate, competitive and within pricing guidelines.
* Advise deal teams on pricing structure, discount levels and commercial options for large and non-standard opportunities.
* Prepare and challenge price, cost and margin analyses and business cases for the CBAB/BAB approval process.
* Create dashboards and tracking models on how far deal prices move from standard price and report the BU's pricing KPIs to management every month.

**Business Unit partnership and investment cases**

* Be the trusted pricing counterpart to Airports & Borders BU leadership.
* Build and defend business cases for the BU Investment Boards.
* Price new and non-catalogue offers and turn them into structured, repeatable price models.

**CPQ operating model: adoption, change management and continuous improvement**

* Own Pricing's part of the CPQ (LogiQuote) operating model: governance, prioritising the backlog, design decisions and Go/No-Go for releases.
* Organize sessions to support and train Solution Design and Commercial Management on CPQ
* Lead change management so that every GEO, Sales, Solution Design and the support functions adopt the new model, with CPQ as the single quoting route.
* Bring new teams, products and business lines (for example Borders) into CPQ, with training, guidance and support for users.
* Improve the model continuously: track adoption and quote quality, find and fix workarounds (such as quotes built in Excel outside CPQ), and extend CPQ to handle complex deal structures.
* Keep data consistent across Salesforce, CPQ and billing, for example quote and opportunity value alignment and item master controls. Work with Billing to improve how orders flow through to invoices.

**Supplier and cost**

* Work with Procurement to keep the cost book accurate and update it regularly with current third-party supplier costs and transfer prices.
* Keep internal software costs current so that pricing models and quotes reflect the true cost base.

**People leadership**

* Lead a team of about 4 pricing professionals: set objectives, manage performance and develop each person.
* Share pricing and CPQ expertise across the team and with GEO stakeholders.

Qualifications:

**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS:**

* 8+ years in pricing, business finance or product management, including 2+ years managing people.
* Mastery of pricing principles and a strong commercial background.
* Proven record of designing pricing strategies that improved margin.
* Strong financial modelling (Excel, business cases, NPV and margin analysis) and data analytics.
* Track record of leading change management and getting large, multi-GEO organisations to adopt new processes or tools.
* Hands-on experience with CPQ and CRM tools such as Salesforce, and with quote-to-cash processes.
* Able to influence and challenge senior stakeholders, including BU heads, GEO presidents and sales leaders.
* Experience in a global, multicultural IT, telecoms or technology business.
* Rigorous attention to detail and excellent written and spoken English.
* Master's in Business, Finance, Marketing or equivalent experience.

**Nice to have**

* Air transport industry experience, especially with airports or border agencies.
* B2B solution pricing, covering software licences, SaaS and services.
* Continuous improvement or Lean experience.
* Power BI or similar tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

**Flex-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*

title: Head of Client Services
description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**About the role**

As Head of Client Services, you'll lead our global partner-facing teams, making sure every partner on the platform gets the right level of support to grow with us.

Our relationship management teams are organised into tier-based pods, providing varied levels of service to our partners. You'll manage these teams and own the post-sales activities and processes, including retention, growth, operational support, and the quality of service they receive every day.

You'll report to the Head of Partner Management and work closely with the Partner Management and Operational Support teams to align processes, tooling and ways of working across the group, while protecting what makes the partner experience special.

* Lead, coach, and line-manage our partner-facing teams. Ensure the team is a high-performing, partner-obsessed Client Services function.
* Own partner retention and growth across the managed book, with clear targets for ticket sales, churn and partner health.
* Design and run our tiered service model – decide what level of service, support, and coverage each partner tier will receive.
* Ensure partner-facing and operational teams work as one, with clear ownership of each partner relationship, smooth handoffs, and collaboration across support teams.
* Use data to guide decisions – build reports and forecasts on partner performance, partner health, service levels and team KPIs, and present insights to internal leadership.
* Handle senior partner escalations and key negotiations, and act as executive sponsor for our largest partners.
* Work cross-functionally with Sales and Business Development, Product, Finance, Event Operations, Customer Support and Marketing to resolve partner issues and feed partner insight into our roadmap.
* Partner with internal teams to align processes, tooling (including Zendesk) and operating model across the group.
* Own team structure, capacity, and headcount planning within budget, and build clear career paths for your teams.
* Champion our story with partners and across the industry.

**Who You Are**

* 10+ years of experience in a partner-facing role.
* Extensive experience leading post-sales and partner-facing teams, e.g. Account Management, Customer Success and Partner Success.
* Demonstrated track record of managing managers within complex, globally distributed teams.
* A leader of leaders who builds trust and helps people grow.
* Data-driven, commercially minded, analytical and results-focused.
* A track record of driving partner retention and revenue growth across a large, tiered client portfolio.
* Confident presenting to senior stakeholders and negotiating with partners.
* Experience building service models, SLAs and KPIs, and running teams with data and CRM/helpdesk tools (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk).
* A stellar communicator with a professional attitude.
* Happy to travel between our global offices.

**Bonus**

* Experience operating within complex B2B environments, digital platforms, or multi-sided marketplaces.
* Experience in the ticketing industry.
* Fluency in one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
* Stock options.
* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
* Gympass membership.
* Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth.
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

title: CS Team Lead
description:
**Who we are**
==============

With a global **mission** to help people live longer, healthier lives, **Docplanner** Group is the world's biggest healthcare platform. We serve patients and healthcare professionals across 13 countries in Europe and LATAM, with a network of more than 2.8 million healthcare professionals and over 20 million bookings every month. Our global team of around 3,000 people works from offices in Warsaw, Istanbul, Rome, Barcelona, Mexico City, Bogotá, Curitiba, Rio, Munich and Berlin.

**About the role**
------------------

Clinic Agenda is growing, and so is the number of clinics that rely on it every day. We are looking for a Team Lead to turn a Customer Success team of around 8 reps into the reason clinics stay and grow with us.

Our Customer Success processes are mature and well established. We expect you to master them quickly and then challenge them: give you feedback on what you think it works, sharpen what doesn't, and move the team from reacting to churn requests to a proactive, commercial and data-driven approach. You will be measured on results, and you will have the autonomy to decide how to get them.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Numbers first.** You open every discussion with data. You know your portfolio's health, churn and expansion figures without having to look them up.
* **Data-driven decisions.** Intuition gives you a hypothesis; data confirms or rejects it. You test, measure and adjust.
* **You escalate always with** **a proposal.** When something needs leadership's attention, you bring the analysis, the options and your recommendation.
* **Ownership and accountability.** You take full ownership of your team's results. When a target is at risk, you are the first to see it, explain it and present the plan to recover it.
* **Outcomes over activity.** You care about results, not about how busy the team looks.
* **You build people.** You set clear expectations, give honest feedback and measure your own success by how much your reps improve. You also take tough decisions if needed.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Build a high-performing team**

* Lead, coach and develop around 8 Customer Success Reps, some of them early in their careers.
* Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s and call reviews, and give direct, actionable feedback.
* Spot skill gaps early, build training plans to close them and track each rep's performance continuously.
* Hire, onboard and grow talent so the team gets stronger.

**Grow the portfolio**

* Co-own with RevOps and CS Manager, the upselling and cross-selling strategy across the existing clinic base.
* Use product usage and customer data to find expansion opportunities and turn them into revenue.

**Protect the base**
