* **Long-term thinking:** We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* **Meaningful experiences:** We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* **Systemic elegance:** We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* **Maker mentality:** We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

**Role overview**  
As GTM Engineer, you will build the systems that allow a small commercial team to operate at the scale of a much larger one. Reporting directly to the Director of Clients, New Business and Institutional Relations, you will design and run the data, automation and AI workflows behind Mormedi's client relationships, campaigns and proposals.

**This role is for you if**  
You move easily between business and technology. You have built or automated something on your own initiative, you get bored doing the same task twice, and you want to see your tools used every day by the people around you.

**What you will own**

* **AI agents and workflows:** building agents and automations for account research, data enrichment, meeting briefings and first drafts.
* **Commercial stack:** connecting and maintaining our CRM, Apollo, LinkedIn, email and event tools into one coherent system.
* **Campaign infrastructure:** setting up the lists, sequences, personalisation and tracking behind growth campaigns.
* **Proposal support tools:** automating the repetitive parts of proposal work, such as tender monitoring, content retrieval and compliance checklists.
* **Data and dashboards:** building the pipeline dashboard the team uses every week to decide where to focus.
* **Tool scouting:** testing new tools and keeping only those that genuinely add value.
* **Responsible AI and data protection:** ensuring every workflow respects GDPR, the EU AI Act, client confidentiality and Mormedi's internal policies.
* **Quality and Environmental standards (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001):** documenting processes and supporting continuous efficiency within the team.

**How success is measured**

* **Systems in use (~70%):** workflows in daily use, hours saved and data quality in the CRM.
* **Impact on results (~30%):** contribution of automation to campaign performance and proposal speed.

**What you bring**

* **Builder mindset:** You have automated something or built a tool on your own. No need to be a software engineer.
* **Technical fluency:** Comfort with APIs, integrations, spreadsheets and data structures.
* **Business sense:** Ability to understand how a commercial team works and where time is lost.
* **Ownership:** You spot what should be built, propose it and prove it works.
* **AI literacy:** Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic workflows, with care for data privacy and confidentiality.

**Software & Tools**

* **Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier or similar.
* **Commercial Tools:** CRM (Copper or similar), Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* **Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools.
* **Data:** Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; dashboarding tools.
* **Nice to have:** Python or JavaScript.

**Languages**  
High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; Italian is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

* Final-year student or recent graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Data, Business Analytics or a related field.
* Eligibility for an internship agreement (convenio de prácticas).
* Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

**What we offer**

* A three-month paid internship at our Madrid office, with a real possibility of joining the team afterwards.
* Direct work with the New Business leadership from the first week, without layers in between.
* Exposure to international clients and projects across aviation, rail, banking, energy and retail.
* A way of understanding business through design and innovation that very few places can teach.

-------

Producer

**Description**
---------------

**About the Company**

As the world’s leading multidisciplinary service provider, Deluxe underpins the media and entertainment industry, servicing content creators and distributors including Netflix, WarnerMedia, The Walt Disney Company, Amazon, Apple, Viacom, NBCU, Google, AT&T and many others, by providing Global Content Distribution, Localization, Accessibility and Mastering while leading end-to-end innovation with unparalleled scale and agility across the Streaming, Theatrical, Broadcast and Mobile landscapes. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices around the globe, the company employs over 3,500 of the most talented and experienced industry individuals worldwide. For more information, please visit www.bydeluxe.com

**Position:** Producer

**Full-Time, Permanent Position**

**Location:** On site - Madrid

**Hours/Shifts:** 40 hours – 09 am to 6pm

**Position Overview**

Coordinate the day-to-day production of assigned graphics localization projects for audiovisual marketing content, including trailers, TV spots and other campaign assets. The Producer will work closely with graphics artists, account management and post-production teams to ensure that briefs are clear, work follows agreed production plans and deliverables meet the required quality standards and deadlines.

The Producer will manage assigned projects independently, working with the Senior Producer on complex requirements, competing priorities and escalations.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Manage assigned graphics localization projects from briefing through to delivery, following agreed production plans and workflows.
* Review incoming requests and ensure that source materials, instructions, specifications and deadlines are complete and clearly understood.
* Plan and monitor assigned projects within agreed priorities and resource allocations, flagging scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns early.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with internal teams and client contacts, providing updates and flagging risks or issues early.
* Track assets, versions, feedback and approvals to ensure that everyone works with the correct materials and latest instructions.
* Coordinate with subtitling, dubbing and post-production teams to ensure that localized graphics, subtitles and audio versions are aligned for final delivery.
* Coordinate reviews and quality checks, ensuring that feedback is accurately implemented and deliverables meet the agreed brief and technical requirements.
* Identify production challenges, resolve routine issues and escalate more complex problems with clear information and proposed next steps
* Keep project records and delivery trackers accurate and up to date.

**Requirements**

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English, including the ability to communicate confidently in meetings, understand briefs and write clear project updates.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage personal workload, time and competing priorities independently.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.
* Ability to work under pressure, respond calmly to changing requirements and find efficient, practical solutions.
* Understanding of design and post-production workflows, including how graphics are created, adapted, reviewed and delivered.
* Familiarity with theatrical localization, post-production and delivery workflows, including subtitling and dubbing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple assets, language versions and rounds of feedback.
* A proactive mindset, with the confidence to clarify requirements, follow up on outstanding actions and escalate issues when needed.
* Previous experience in production coordination, creative services or audiovisual post-production, with the ability to manage assigned projects independently.

**Diversity Statement**

Deluxe is committed to inclusivity, fostering an environment where every employee feels comfortable bringing their full selves to work. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against, based on race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

title: Audiovisual Producer, Commercial Video
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Madrid, ES

En Condé Nast Commercial Creative CNCC buscamos un/a **Audiovisual Producer** con sólidos conocimientos técnicos, experiencia práctica en rodajes y una mentalidad ágil, resolutiva e innovadora.

El/La **Audiovisual Producer** supervisará la producción de contenidos audiovisuales comerciales para Vogue, GQ, Vanity Fair, AD y Condé Nast Traveler, colaborando con anunciantes de moda, lujo, belleza, viajes, cultura y estilo de vida. Buscamos un/a profesional versátil con sólidos conocimientos técnicos y experiencia práctica en rodajes para gestionar producciones de diversas escalas. El perfil ideal combinará la excelencia técnica con modelos de producción ágiles e innovadores para optimizar tiempos y presupuestos sin comprometer la calidad.

**Responsabilidades clave**

* **Producción integral:** Planificar, presupuestar y ejecutar proyectos de branded content, campañas comerciales y vídeo para redes sociales desde la preproducción hasta la entrega final.
* **Gestión de recursos y proveedores:** Definir las necesidades técnicas y humanas de cada proyecto, seleccionar proveedores y negociar con productoras y profesionales independientes (freelancers).
* **Supervisión técnica:** Controlar la ejecución en el set de rodaje, garantizando los estándares de calidad, el cumplimiento de los plazos y un estricto control presupuestario.
* **Innovación y nuevos formatos:** Explorar e integrar herramientas de inteligencia artificial, automatización y formatos social-first (vídeo vertical, podcasts, transmisiones en directo) en los flujos de trabajo.
* **Colaboración interdepartamental:** Trabajar junto a los equipos de Commercial Video, Diseño, Brand Marketing, Ventas y Delivery, aportando criterio técnico y estimaciones económicas en la fase de preventa.

**Requisitos y habilidades esenciales**

* Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en producción audiovisual en productoras de vídeo, agencias creativas o entornos de branded content.
* Licenciatura, diplomatura en áreas relacionadas con las funciones del puesto.
* Experiencia práctica en la organización de rodajes, coordinación de equipos, gestión de presupuestos y resolución de incidencias bajo presión.
* Conocimientos técnicos sólidos en cámaras, ópticas, iluminación, sonido, flujos de trabajo de postproducción y dinámicas de grabación y realización de podcasts y videopodcasts.
* Dominio de herramientas de edición como Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects o similares.
* Comprensión profunda de los requisitos de contenido, formatos y tendencias de Instagram, TikTok y YouTube.
* Sensibilidad estética, atención al detalle, visión de negocio
* Nivel fluido de inglés para trabajar en una compañía global.

**Se valorará especialmente:**

* Trayectoria demostrable como auxiliar, coordinador/a o jefe/a de producción en proyectos digitales de pequeña, mediana y gran escala.
* Experiencia práctica en formatos de televisión digital, configuraciones multicámara, entretenimiento o retransmisiones en vivo.
* Red propia de colaboradores, profesionales y proveedores audiovisuales en España.
* La experiencia de trabajo en entornos internacionales.

**Buscamos a alguien que ame producir, que sepa resolver y que tenga ganas de encontrar nuevas y mejores formas de hacer las cosas.**

MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.

We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.

He/She brings practical service knowledge into digital delivery: understanding customer, operational, commercial and regulatory needs, shaping how customers reach us and how we respond, and building a support function that is fast, compliant, measurable and AI-assisted by design rather than by retrofit.

The role covers the customer-facing layer of the end-to-end journey (from contracting to first bill, collection and service) across the contact channels, self-service area and support tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own customer ticketing and service, customer engagement, the continuous optimisation of support including its tools, and claim management, end to end.

* Design the omnichannel service model across phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, app and self-service portal

* Act as business owner for the support stack — CRM and ticketing, telephony/CCaaS, knowledge base, survey and QA tooling: define functional requirements, target design and evaluation criteria, support the IT organisation in vendor and partner selection, and drive business validation before go-live
* Hire, structure and lead the customer operations team; define roles, career paths, training curriculum and onboarding

* Collaborate across Growth, Offering, Operations and Finance on the business side, and Product, UX, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side

* University degree

title: Senior MEAL Manager
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Program Brief**

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solution driven, passionate changemaker, come join us positively impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future.

Since 2017, IRC has supported Rohingya Refugees and Bangladeshi nationalities communities in Cox's Bazar, Khulna, Barisal, and Chittagong with integrated services. The organization also addresses climate change impacts by building resilience and promoting economic recovery, education, and protection.

**Purpose of the role:**

The Senior MEAL Manager leads all MEAL work for the consortium. This is a full-time, hands-on role in the Program Management Unit (PMU), which manages day-to-day delivery of the project.

In this role, the post holder will:

* Set the MEAL framework and standards for the whole consortium.
* Collect, check and combine indicator data from IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners.
* Make sure DFAT-funded results are clearly attributed and that each client is counted only once.
* Build the MEAL skills of partner organizations.

Partners differ widely in capacity and resources, so the role works with a good degree of independence day to day. The aim is high-quality results, not just compliance. The post holder is supported by the Assessment and Learning (A&L) Manager, the Management Information System (MIS) Manager and IRC sector MEAL Managers and receives technical oversight from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality.

**Work Location:** IRC Bangladesh, Cox’s Bazar Office

**Contract Length:** 31st October 2027 (with possibility of extension subject to funding, program needs and performance of incumbent)

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Consortium MEAL framework and strategic ownership:**

* Design, maintain and regularly update the consortium-wide MEAL framework and MEAL Plan, including the Program Logic, log frame, MEL framework, Performance Indicator Reference Sheets (PIRS) and Indicator Tracking Table (ITT), in line with DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards (February 2026) and Development Evaluation Policy (2026), IRC MEAL policies and IRC’s global strategy, Strategy100. Ensure the framework, MEAL Plan, PIRS and standardized tools are approved and used by all partners.
* Own the consortium’s MEAL standard and practice. Contextualize existing IRC tools, standards and MEAL systems for the consortium rather than building parallel systems. Lead the standard MEAL methods, tools and reporting system, and strengthen partners’ capacity to use them.
* Agree with all partners how each indicator is defined and calculated, what data is collected, which tools are used, how often and with what sampling, and who is responsible. Ensure every partner applies the same definitions and protocols and understands the PIRS.
* Lead the annual Program Logic review and monitoring of key assumptions and risks with partners and contribute monitoring evidence to the consortium risk register.

**Data collection, consolidation, analysis and reporting:**

* Collect, clean, validate, analyze and compile project data for all indicators across IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners, for both monitoring and reporting.
* Ensure all partners collect data using CommCare-based tools and upload it daily to one central server and check the data routinely on dashboards.
* Maintain one common ITT for all partners (used for annual reporting) and analyze CommCare MIS data and the Program Indicator Dashboard (PID) monthly to assess progress and identify priority areas for targeted monitoring. Update the ITT and performance dashboards every month.
* Ensure data is consistently broken down by sex, age, gender, disability and location on every record (using the Washington Group Short Set on Functioning to identify persons with disabilities), and clear attribution of DFAT-funded results through project-specific codes in the MIS, addressing any attribution gaps through agreed data-sharing protocols and monthly data quality reviews.
* Apply DFAT’s unique client counting approach across all partners, using the program-specific client identifier in CommCare to count each individual once at service, sector and program level, and report unique reach against the target of 210,841 individuals by sector, sex, age, gender and disability. Ensure program data reported to DFAT is accurate, complete and donor compliant.
* Set and enforce common data management rules for all partners, covering file naming, storage, version control and data sharing.
* Ensure sensitive GBV and child protection case data remain within GBVIMS+ and CPIMS+ and agreed information-sharing protocols, with only aggregated, anonymized data used in consortium and DFAT reporting.
* Run routine consortium-wide analysis to identify programmatic, geographic, thematic and capacity gaps, including gaps in reaching the most at-risk groups (women and girls, children, adolescents and persons with disabilities) in line with JRP Priority 1 criteria, and flag them promptly to the PMU, outside the regular reporting cycle were urgent.
* Develop and monitor Value for Money (VfM) indicators aligned with DFAT’s 4Es framework (economy, efficiency, effectiveness and equity), including cost per client, cost per output and service utilization rates, working with Finance and sector leads and comparing results across delivery models and against sector benchmarks, and review the results with partners at program performance reviews.
* Prepare quarterly narrative and monitoring reports in consortium-agreed formats, and the MEAL inputs for DFAT annual performance reporting (led by the Program Coordinator, in the 8+3 format and aligned with DFAT’s whole-of-program indicators), with dashboards developed together with the MIS Manager. Submit reports on time and provide the DFAT inputs on schedule.

**Routine and process monitoring:**

* Lead a standardized process monitoring approach with tools and checklists for health and nutrition, protection, child protection and GBV, WASH, education, livelihoods, and emergency preparedness and response, covering quality, whether services are delivered as designed, inclusiveness, timeliness and the functioning of cross-sectoral referral pathways, with safeguarding, AAP and GEDSI built in.
* Monitor service quality, continuity, client access and satisfaction during the phased transition of services to Bangladeshi Partners, in line with the Partner Capacity building and Handover Plan, and report findings and corrective actions to the PMU and DFAT.
* Select activities for monthly spot checks based on MIS analysis (geographic coverage, program component, data quality performance and risk), and conduct spot checks with partner MEAL staff using digital tools.
* Plan and lead joint field visits with sector teams and partners, so that teams learn from one another (proposed monthly, and a longer 2–3 day visit each quarter covering all partners’ project areas).
* Review monitoring findings monthly with sector leads, and present consolidated findings at quarterly Program Performance Review and Reflection meetings, tracking agreed corrective actions to completion.

**Data quality assurance:**

* Check the quality of partner-reported data by verifying it, applying validation rules, cleaning it with a clear record of changes, and giving partners feedback.
* Lead annual Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) using IRC’s DQA methodology, adapted to DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards, and ensure at least 10% of reported data is verified against source documents each quarter during field visits.
* Lead on-site data verification and routine spot checks of CommCare records against registers, attendance sheets and case files (verifying sensitive GBV and child protection records only through agreed confidential protocols).
* Follow up DQA findings with agreed corrective actions and track them to completion and ensure compliance with IRC’s Data Quality Management Framework.

**Baseline, surveys, evaluations and research:**

* Use the baseline survey (completed in November 2026) as the benchmark for tracking change and refining targets, lead the internally managed outcome surveys (including the Year 2 midline) in line with the PIRS collection frequencies, coordinate the independent external endline survey in Year 3, and provide technical coordination of the Joint Program Review at around Month 18 (including the evaluation questions, validation workshop and joint action-planning workshop). Deliver all survey, review and evaluation activities on schedule.
* Develop Terms of Reference, methodologies, sampling plans (95% confidence level, 5% margin of error), tools and analysis plans, and oversee enumerators (IRC-enrolled incentive workers) and partner field supervisors, including daily data checks through dashboards, and ensure enumerators are trained in research ethics, safeguarding, PSEA, informed consent and sensitive-topic data collection.
* Prepare the Scope of Work in consultation with DFAT and share it before the evaluation team is recruited; procure and manage the independent final evaluation to DFAT’s quality and ethical standards and coordinate the management response and action plan and the learning workshop.
* Facilitate research as relevant to DFAT, such as KAP and SMART surveys, outcome harvesting, formative and multisector research, and coordinate with the protection and GEDSI teams so that the program-wide GEDSI analysis and protection analyses inform targeting and adaptation.
* Coordinate methodologies and reporting with DFAT’s external MEL provider.

**Accountability to affected populations:**

* Ensure there is one consortium-wide Client Feedback and Response Mechanism (CFRM) and coordinate it, building on existing partner systems, with safe, accessible and inclusive channels (adapted for persons with disabilities, women with restricted mobility, children and non-literate community members).
* Ensure feedback is recorded in the CommCare MIS and handled through IRC’s 4R approach (Receive, Refer, Respond, Reply), and that communities are told what action was taken.
* Ensure sensitive complaints, including safeguarding, PSEA and misconduct concerns, are referred immediately through safe, confidential pathways to IRC’s Ethics and Compliance Unit and are reported only in aggregate.
* Align CFRM complaint categories with the Common Feedback Platform (CFP) harmonized referral standards, coordinate with CFP focal points and inter-agency accountability mechanisms and refer out-of-scope concerns appropriately.
* Analyze feedback trends together with monitoring data, including signs of inclusion or exclusion errors in targeting, and work with the Community Mobilization, Community Engagement & AAP CoP so findings lead to changes in the program.
* Lead the annual multi-sectoral client satisfaction survey and ensure child-friendly and inclusive feedback methods capture the views of women, girls, boys, older persons and persons with disabilities.

**Learning and adaptive management:**

* Develop and maintain the consortium Learning Agenda (finalized with DFAT and partners) and learning logs and facilitate evidence-to-action processes so findings lead to program changes, including evidence-to-action briefs shared with DFAT, partners and JRP coordination platforms.
* Organize the quarterly reflection sessions, annual learning workshop and the Evidence-to-Action Plan following the Joint Program Review.
* Document and share learning briefs, case studies and good practices with partners, DFAT, other CoPs and IRC technical networks, working with the Communications team.
* Promote Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), Value for Money, localization and safeguarding in all MEAL analysis and learning, drawing on the technical leadership of CDD on disability inclusion and Nari Maitree on gender equality and social inclusion.

**Partner MEAL capacity strengthening and localization:**

* Assess partner MEAL capacity, jointly with partners and in step with the joint organizational capacity assessments and develop a tailored capacity strengthening and sharing plan covering data collection, analysis, reporting and use of data. Implement the plan and document progress.
* Provide training, mentoring, coaching and supportive supervision to partner MEAL staff, and give regular feedback on adherence to agreed tools and standards, while drawing on partners’ own expertise through peer-to-peer, bi-directional capacity sharing.
* Support the gradual handover of MEAL systems, tools and decision-making to Bangladeshi Partners, consistent with the localization-first approach and the Partner capacity building and handover plan.
* Track and report the program’s localization indicators, including the share of funding passed to Bangladeshi Partners and partner leadership of MEAL functions.

**MEAL Community of Practice:**

* Manage the MEAL CoP, which brings together MEAL focal points from IRC and all partners to harmonize tools, review data quality and share learning, guided by one Learning Agenda, and lead its work, with technical support from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality and in coordination with the NGO Forum MEAL Manager (co-lead).
* Prepare the Learning Agenda and meeting agendas, run peer learning sessions, technical clinics, joint problem-solving and peer reviews, and hold the monthly informal sharing meeting and quarterly formal meeting.
* Maintain the shared repository of MEAL tools and learning products and the common action tracker and escalate matters needing management decisions to the PMU.

**Coordination and representation:**

* Represent consortium MEAL directly to DFAT, and present key monitoring and feedback findings to the PMU and, where relevant, the CPF, using aggregate data only (never individual client information) and including community feedback and the changes made in response, which is a standing CPF agenda item.
* Work with the Head of MEAL & Program Quality, Program Coordinator, A&L Manager, MIS Manager, sector MEAL Managers and the NGO Forum MEAL Manager as set out above.
* Represent IRC in inter-agency MEAL, information management, accountability and assessment working groups as required.

**Others:**

* Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC [team/office]
* Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies.

**Key Working Relationships:**

**Position Reports To:** Head of MEAL & Program Quality

**Internal:** MIS Manager, IRC sector MEAL Managers, NGO Forum MEAL Manager, Related CoPs

**External:** Partner MEAL focal points (Nari Maitree, Breaking the Silence, CDD, FIVDB and CNRS), DFAT and its external MEL provider

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive MEAL experience in humanitarian and development settings, including at least 3 years in senior or lead roles managing MEAL systems for multi-partner programs.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competences:**

* Demonstrated experience in strengthening MEAL capacity of local and national partner organizations, and in localization approaches.
* Experience with DFAT (including its Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards and Value for Money framework) or comparable institutional donor requirements (for example US Government, ECHO or OCHA) for compliance, reporting and indicator measurement.
* Experience in at least three of the following sectors: protection, health, WASH, education, GBV, livelihoods and resilience, in humanitarian settings.
* Experience leading baselines, surveys, evaluations and research studies.
* Experience designing and managing multi-partner data systems, including unique client counting and de-duplication, and client feedback and response mechanisms in humanitarian settings.
* Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, SPSS, Kobo and CommCare; PowerApps and DHIS2 desirable.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analysis skills, and experience developing dashboards and automated reporting systems.
* Knowledge of data protection, safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA), GEDSI and accountability principles, including the ethical handling of sensitive GBV and child protection data.
* GIS/QGIS skills are highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions with partners at different capacity levels.
* Strong coaching, facilitation and collaboration skills, with a partner-led and respectful approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.
* Female Candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

**Specific Educational Qualification:**

* Master’s degree preferred in statistics, sociology, public health, development studies, economics, social sciences, demography, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field; or minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with additional relevant experience.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.
* Build internal capability in advanced modelling techniques, external data utilisation, and pricing technology tools running knowledge-sharing sessions and supporting technical upskilling.
* Foster a high-performance pricing culture grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness, and a drive for continuous innovation.
* Identify and develop talent within the team; support succession planning aligned with Allianz Partners' people strategy and the RSA pricing function's long-term growth.

What you will bring
  
  
EXPERIENCE BACKGROUND
  
  

* 10+ years in pricing, actuarial, or underwriting roles with deep expertise in PC or assistance/travel insurance pricing.
* Minimum 3 years leading a pricing function, with direct management of international teams of 5+ FTEs.
* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, or comparable GLM/ML actuarial platforms.
* Demonstrated track record integrating external data sources and third-party platforms into pricing models in a production environment.
* Experience presenting pricing strategy and modelling outcomes to CRO, CFO, or Board-level stakeholders.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage given the global scope.

TECHNICAL MODELLING SKILLS
  
  

* Expert-level command of GLM-based rating engine development; proficiency in GBMs, Random Forests, and other ML techniques applied to insurance pricing.
* Hands-on with WTW Radar and/or Emblem for rate relativities, model fitting, and scenario testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for pricing analytics, model automation, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) and their application to insurance pricing pipelines.
* Experience with external data integration: geo-spatial data (e.g., Verisk, CoreLogic), medical cost databases, telematics feeds, open weather/climate APIs, and socio-demographic enrichment layers.
* Knowledge of pricing optimisation and elasticity modelling techniques, including demand modelling and customer lifetime value frameworks.
* Solid grounding in actuarial concepts: profit testing, reserving, reinsurance structures, and PL interpretation (GWP, NEP, loss ratio, CoR).

EDUCATION
  
  

* Degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Actuarial qualification or progress toward one (FIA, FCAS, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

title: Technical Writer
description:
TANlock, a dormakaba Group company, is a fast-growing technology business specializing in intelligent high-security access solutions for data centers and other critical infrastructure. Since joining the dormakaba Group in July 2025, TANlock has gained access to a global network, expanded international market reach, and exciting new growth opportunities. At the same time, we continue to operate with the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit that define our company culture. Based in Georgensgmünd near Nuremberg, our dedicated team develops advanced electromechanical rack locking systems, versatile authentication modules and smart IP readers that help secure server and control cabinets around the world.

  

Position overview

This exciting expansion role requires an experienced technical pre-sales manager to lead our pre-sales engineering processes and team across the EMEA, USA, and Asia territories. Reporting directly to the Global Head of Sales, you will work closely with TANlock Regional Sales Managers and inside sales to provide deep technical and business support to new and existing key customers, distributors, resellers, and integrators.

You will serve as technical pre-sales leader and become the "voice of the customer," bridging the gap between our go-to-market teams, our TANlock Sentinel channel partners and our Germany HQ engineering, product, and operations teams.

What you will do

Technical Strategy & Consultation

* Solution Architecture: Discover customer technical pain points to recommend the optimal TANlock configurations (Biometric, RFID, PIN or mechanical locks).
* Integration: Advise/recommend clients on integrating TANlock with 3rd party access control providers, operating systems and management platforms.
* Technical Ecosystem expansion: Build in TANlock technical solutions alongside partner ecosystem OEMs and integrator systems.
  

Partner & Sales Enablement

* Trust Building: Identify and build credibility and authority with client network, IP, and security tech teams to design, test, and validate products for critical infrastructure sites.
* Channel Onboarding: Build and deliver technical training workshops to onboard partners into the Sentinel program for all TANlock products

title: Managing Tech Lead - Europa Universalis V
description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

**Practical information**
-------------------------

Scope: Full-time and permanent

Location: Sitges, Barcelona (Spain)

WFH/WFO: 100% onsite

Reports to: Head of Operations

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
* Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
* Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
* Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
* Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
* Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
****Role Objective****
****AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.****
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (50+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 50+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

****Working Hours & Culture****

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

**How To Apply & What To Expect**
At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

**Company Description**
Our Client is a real estate developer creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, with an intelligent agent that learns its occupants and adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity. Their approach is built around the idea that a smart home should know you, care for you and make you healthier over time, not just act as a remote control on an app.
  
  
Our Client runs a lab and experience centre where products are tested with real residents and office users, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation, with a mandate to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product, UX & Design to own what our client builds and how it feels. The client is creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, spaces with an intelligent agent that learns their occupants and continuously adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will lead all product owners, product managers, designers and creative talent. You will turn the CAIO's vision into clear product roadmaps and an unmistakably premium experience across every touchpoint: the super app, wall switches, smart mirrors, voice, a 3D AI agent, and the physical spaces themselves.
  
  
We are looking for a design superhero with product leadership depth: someone of the calibre found at Apple, Uber, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut or leading health-tech companies. You must hold a very high bar, and be confident enough to push back when something isn't good enough.
  
  
**Reporting & Team**
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
  
  
Key partners: Head of Technology (engineering delivery); Technical Program Manager; Marketing & Brand (including external brand agencies); Sales & Go-to-Market
  
  
Leads:
  
  

* Product owners: Agentic Intelligence, PWA / Super App, Hardware & IoT. Each owns their product end to end and partners day to day with the Head of Technology's engineering teams
* Product management: Product Managers and Product Associates reporting into each product owner
* UX Design: UX Design Manager, Product Designers, UX/UI Designers
* Creative & Graphics: Graphic Design Manager, Senior Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Leadership & Roadmap
* Own the product strategy and roadmap across the client's three product lines: the agentic intelligence layer, the PWA / super app, and the hardware & IoT experience
* Lead and grow the product owners, giving each a clear mandate, outcomes and accountability for delivering a complete, working product with their engineering counterparts
* Turn the CAIO's vision into prioritised, sequenced roadmaps that balance residential first (the current priority), commercial workplaces, and later hospitality
* Define success metrics and run the product cadence (discovery, PRDs, sprint reviews, launch readiness) together with the Technical Program Manager
* The Super App & Customer Journey
* Own the end-to-end journey in the PWA, evolving it into the super app for agentic living:

+ Pre-sales: an AI-guided digital brochure, delivered through brokers, that helps buyers choose an apartment and its customisations
+ Onboarding: the resident "interviews" their home agent, building their profile, preferences and household setup (with privacy between family members)
+ Handover: construction updates, fit-out choices and move-in readiness
+ Living: daily control and wellness insights, plus communicating with the home from anywhere

* Design for multiple modalities (chat, voice, a 3D/avatar agent and touch) while keeping the experience simple for people who don't want to "talk to AI"
* UX, Interaction & Design Systems
* Build and own the design system across app, web, wall switches, smart mirrors, tablets and in-space displays
* Define the interaction language for ambient, mostly invisible automation: how the space shows what it is doing, what it detected, and how the occupant can override it
* Champion research and usability testing with real residents and office users in the lab and Experience Centre
* Set and protect a world-class quality bar for micro-interactions, motion and polish
* Creative Direction & Brand Expression
* Lead the creative and graphics team: visual design, motion graphics, product storyboards and sales/marketing assets
* Partner with Marketing and the brand agency so that the brand direction (bold and colourful, "Nike meets Apple", glassmorphism and neumorphism, biophilic cues) shows up consistently in the product
* Produce product vision videos and prototypes that make an invisible, passive experience visible and compelling to investors, buyers and partners
* Wellness, Data & Trust
* Translate biometric and wellness data (from wearables such as Whoop, Oura and Ultrahuman, and from in-space sensing) into insights and nudges people actually act on, without being creepy
* Make privacy and consent a first-class part of the experience, working with the Head of Technology on privacy-by-design

**Requirements**
**Requirements**
**Product & Design Leadership Requirements**

* Product Leadership: Product strategy, roadmapping, OKRs, managing product owners/managers, outcome-based prioritisation
* UX & Interaction: Multi-platform UX (mobile, web/PWA, embedded displays), conversational and voice UX, prototyping, user research
* Visual & Creative: Design systems, typography, motion design, brand-to-product translation; strong portfolio required
* AI Product Literacy: Understanding of LLMs and agents, and how to design trustworthy, explainable AI experiences
* Tooling: Figma (expert), prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer or similar), After Effects/motion tooling, analytics platforms
* Collaboration: Proven partnership with engineering leadership; experience working with external agencies
* Leadership: Built and led combined product + design teams of 10+; hiring and mentoring across seniority levels

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hardware-Adjacent Products: Experience designing products that extend beyond the screen into smart home, IoT, wearables, automotive or connected devices
* Health/Wellness Tech: Product or design leadership at a health-tech or wearables company (e.g. Whoop, Oura, Ultrahuman, Eight Sleep) is a strong plus
* Consumer Super Apps: Experience at companies known for design excellence and complex consumer journeys (e.g. Apple, Uber, Careem, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut)
* Zero-to-One Experience: You have built a product and a team from scratch, not just optimised an existing one
* Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: You will push back on a bad idea, including the CEO's, and change your mind when the evidence says so

**Why This Role?**
Most real-estate "smart homes" are a remote control on an app. Our client is building something different: homes and workplaces that know you, care for you and make you healthier over time. You will define the face, voice and feel of that intelligence, from the first time a buyer meets the client's agent on a broker's tablet to the moment a resident's bathroom mirror suggests a better night's sleep. You will have the mandate, the team and the executive support to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Additional Suggestions For The Candidate**

* Portfolio Is Everything: Please include case studies that show product thinking and craft, ideally including motion and multi-device work
* Think Beyond the Screen: Come ready to discuss how you would design an experience where the best interaction is often no interaction at all
* Bring a Point of View: Tell us one thing you would change about how today's smart home apps work, and how you would do it better

**Benefits**

* Offered Salary: Competitive, in line with market standards for the role and seniority, along with additional benefits as per the company's band structure

title: Executive Director, Head of Learning Strategy, Design & Learner Experience
description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  
The Executive Director, Head of Learning Strategy, Design & Learner Experience is a member of the Learning & Development Leadership Team responsible for shaping and executing the enterprise learning strategy and creating modern, high-impact learning experiences that build workforce capability and support business performance.

This leader oversees **learning strategy, enterprise learning design, curriculum and content, learner experience, learning technology strategy, AI-enabled learning, analytics, and the Learning Design Center of Excellence**. In close partnership with DDAT/HR Technology, the role translates L&D priorities and learner needs into the technology capabilities and digital experiences required to enable them.

The role sets enterprise standards and drives innovation across the learning ecosystem, improving **quality, speed, scalability, accessibility, learner experience, and business impact** while simplifying how learning is designed and delivered.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Learning Strategy & Governance**

* Define and execute the enterprise learning strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with business, talent, skills, and workforce priorities.
* Establish enterprise standards and governance for learning design, curriculum architecture, content, accessibility, learner experience, and measurement.
* Translate business and workforce capability needs into scalable learning strategies and solutions.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders on learning, skills, AI, and workforce capability trends.

**Learning Design & Learner Experience**

* Lead the Learning Design Center of Excellence and end-to-end design and development of enterprise learning experiences across digital, virtual, instructor-led, multimedia, performance support, immersive, and AI-enabled modalities.
* Establish modern learning design and learner experience principles grounded in learning science, accessibility, user experience, and measurable performance outcomes.
* Drive consistency, quality, reuse, modularity, and scalability across enterprise curricula and content.
* Lead the strategy and learner experience for **Classroom of the Future**, partnering with DDAT on enabling technology products and capabilities.
* Oversee learning demand, prioritization, capacity, and delivery to balance strategic initiatives with ongoing business and regulatory needs.

**Learning Technology & Digital Enablement**

* Serve as L&D's strategic partner to DDAT/HR Technology, translating learning and learner experience requirements into technology capabilities and roadmaps.
* Partner on the strategy, governance, selection, optimization, and evolution of the learning technology ecosystem, including LMS/LXP, skills platforms, authoring tools, AI, coaching, content, and analytics solutions.
* Represent L&D priorities in enterprise technology and talent ecosystem decisions.
* Drive adoption and continuous improvement of digital learning experiences while ensuring scalability, integration, security, and compliance.

**AI, Innovation & Transformation**

* Lead adoption of approved AI, automation, and emerging technologies to transform how learning is designed, developed, delivered, and experienced.
* Establish modern design and development practices that improve personalization, accessibility, speed, quality, and productivity.
* Create a culture of experimentation, rapid iteration, and data-driven continuous improvement.
* Evaluate emerging learning capabilities and partners and scale solutions that demonstrate measurable value.

**Analytics & Business Impact**

* Establish measurement frameworks and KPIs for learning effectiveness, learner experience, capability development, technology adoption, operational performance, and business impact.
* Use learner, skills, operational, and business data to guide investment, design decisions, and continuous improvement.
* Provide executive-level insights on the effectiveness and value of enterprise learning investments.

**Enterprise & People Leadership**

* Build strong partnerships across the business, HR, Talent, DDAT/HR Technology, Information Security, Procurement, and external partners.
* Lead and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team across learning design, digital learning, content, technology, and learner experience.
* Build team capability in learning science, AI, analytics, experience design, and emerging technologies.
* Manage resources, vendors, budgets, and investments to deliver measurable business value and operational efficiency.

**Leadership & Technical Capabilities**

* Enterprise learning strategy and workforce capability development
* Learning science, instructional design, curriculum architecture, and learner experience design
* Learning technology ecosystems including LMS/LXP, content, skills, AI, and analytics platforms
* AI-enabled learning design, content development, and automation
* Learning analytics, measurement, and business-impact evaluation
* Accessibility, content governance, and digital learning standards
* Strategic thinking with strong execution and transformation leadership
* Executive influence, communication, and cross-functional leadership
* Data-driven decision making and financial acumen
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and translate strategy into measurable outcomes

**Location**

East Coast/Midwest (preferred); Remote (open)

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in learning and development, talent/capability development, learning design, or learning technology, including significant enterprise leadership experience.
* Experience developing and executing enterprise learning strategies, operating models, and large-scale transformations.
* Experience leading learning design, curriculum, content development, learner experience, or Learning Design Center of Excellence functions.
* Experience partnering with technology/product organizations to shape enterprise learning platforms and digital experiences.
* experience applying **AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technology** to learning and development (preferred)
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing enterprise learning demand, resources, vendors, and delivery.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and lead effectively across complex, cross-functional organizations.
Travel - 1 week/month to and/or based on the needs of the business
