At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As the Senior Director of Design, Governance & Compliance at Vanta, you'll lead design for our largest product pillar. You'll set the direction for how compliance work moves from manual workflows to agents that do the work alongside our customers.

Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. Those companies range from founders getting their first SOC2 to global enterprises managing hundreds of controls. As we move upmarket, the team's job is to make that complexity feel simple for every customer, at every size.

You’ll lead a team of senior, staff, and principal designers, with senior managers and directors reporting to you. You'll report to the Head of Design and partner as a peer with product and engineering leadership for the pillar. We're not starting from scratch. Vanta Agent works across the product, customers build and deploy their own custom agents, and our designers prototype and ship to production with our own AI design harness. Your job is to make that the way the whole pillar works.

**What you’ll do as a Senior Director of Design at Vanta:**

* Lead the agentic direction for Governance & Compliance. Build on the agents we've already shipped, define what comes next, and shape how people and agents work together across the pillar
* Own design quality across the pillar. Set the bar, drive consistency from concept to ship, and get into the details yourself when it matters
* Design for platform and enterprise complexity. Lead the team through cross-cutting decisions on scoping, segmentation, org units, permissions, and multi-entity audits so the system holds together across surfaces
* Bring AI into how the team works. Build on our design harness, help every designer prototype and ship faster, and keep craft high as speed goes up
* Lead and grow leaders. Develop your design leaders and senior ICs, build a high-trust team, and hire well as the pillar grows
* Partner as a peer with product and engineering. Co-own outcomes and quality with your counterparts, not just the design work

**How to be successful in this role:**

* You've shipped agentic or AI-forward products and have a point of view on how design changes when outputs are non-deterministic
* You use AI hands-on in your own process, from prototyping to building in a harness or in code, and you bring your team along
* You have deep enterprise B2B SaaS experience. You understand custom configurations, multi-org workflows, and large deployments, and you've made complex products feel simple
* You think in systems, designing object models and patterns that hold up across many surfaces, not just individual flows
* You're comfortable going deep with engineers in a technical, domain-heavy space like GRC
* You've led teams of 12 or more, including design directors, design managers, and staff ICs, and you move easily between strategy and the details
* You have a portfolio showing how you've simplified complex products and shipped AI-forward experiences (required for interview)
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship
* Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results
* Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar

**What you can expect as a Vanta’n:**

* Industry-competitive salary and equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
* 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
* Health & wellness stipend
* Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
* Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
* Family planning benefits
* Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
* Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
* 11 company-paid holidays
* Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
* Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

*At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.*

**About Vanta**

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

title: Director, Communications | Full-Time | Remote
description:
Oak View Group:

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary:

Oak View Group’s Global Marketing team creates engaging, high-impact storytelling opportunities in media that drive company growth and enhance OVG’s visibility. We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented **Director, Communications** to join our team. The Director, Communications is responsible for external communications and storytelling of Oak View Group’s hospitality team and select business verticals in desired media. The candidate will work closely with the VP of Communications and leaders to develop proactive communications strategies aligned with key prospects and target audiences. The Director, Communications will serve as a vital resource for managed venues, ensuring alignment and consistency of messaging across the US & Canada, promoting key milestones, and working closely with venue staff to do so.

This role will pay a salary of $150,000 to $160,000 and is bonus eligible.

**Benefits for FT roles: Benefits: Health, Dental and Vision insurance, 401(k) savings plan, 401(k) matching, and paid time off (vacation days, sick days, and 12 holidays).**

**This position will remain open until February 12, 2027.**

Responsibilities:

* Create and implement external communications strategies that are supportive of and advance Oak View Group’s brand identity and business objectives in priority verticals in business and consumer press.
* Proactively develop opportunities and collaborations to place stories and promote key spokespeople.
* Develop and maintain active contact with press and influencers that benefit Oak View Group’s business verticals, including serving as primary contact for OVG Hospitality and related properties.
* Work with venue teams and internal business leaders to develop news-worthy content that drives story-telling efforts and supports Oak View Group’s overall PR strategy.
* Collaborate with Marketing team on content creation and story ideas for promotion on OVG corporate channels.
* Partner cross-functionally with groups, including social media and content teams, to drive announcement content of new business, sustainability efforts, and bespoke content that drives engagement and shines a light on our partners.
* Bring strong media relationships across key areas including hospitality (both consumer and trade), lifestyle, sports, and entertainment, including both national and local.
* Create and maintain an Editorial Calendar to assist with the promotion of strategic communications initiatives to include important milestones, events, and seasons.
* Identify and create media opportunities for leadership to tell the Oak View Group story in priority verticals in target media. Develop messaging, prepare briefing materials, and brief spokespersons in preparation for media interviews.
* Support crisis communications plan development and deployment with the goal of protecting Oak View Group overall, its brands, and assets, and reinforcing its reputation as a responsible entity.
* Support the continued evolution of the company’s crisis response capability, including ongoing review and development of crisis communication processes and procedures.
* Be an enthusiastic champion for OVG.
* Build relationships with business and PR leaders in each vertical business.
* Develop and monitor PR KPIs and report monthly.
* Additional job duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, or a related field required.
* 5-7+ years of previous communications experience in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills: detail-focused, able to handle multiple tasks/projects at a time.
* Strategic thinker with creative approach to story ideas and media outreach.
* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
* Demonstrated success collaborating with teams.
* Experience in the hospitality, live entertainment, or sports industry preferred.
* Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel).
* Familiarity with Canva, Staffbase, and other graphics software.
* Establish and maintain effective interpersonal working relationships.
* Listen effectively, assess the situation, determine relevant issues, & suggest solutions.
* Ability to work nights, events, and weekends as required.
* Ability to travel as required.

Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference:

At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our **people**, improves our **service**, and raises our **excellence**. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds.

title: Vice President, Patient Services - Remote
description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. title: Director of Planning | Poppy & Peonies
description:
Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Director of Brand & Social to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity!

  

Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally.

Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born.

We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!

We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint.

**About the Role**

The Director of Planning will lead the integrated Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Inventory Planning functions at Poppy & Peonies.

This role is responsible for translating commercial plans into actionable inventory and purchasing strategies, ensuring the right products are available in the right quantities, at the right locations, and at the right time.

Working closely with Merchandising, Product Development, Marketing, Finance, Sourcing, and Operations, the Director will establish a disciplined Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process that balances revenue growth, product availability, inventory productivity, and cash flow.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and financial acumen with hands-on planning experience in a fast-paced consumer products environment. They are comfortable working at both strategic and operational levels, building scalable processes while actively managing forecasts, inventory, and purchasing decisions.

### **The Opportunity**

**Demand Planning & Forecasting**

* Own the end-to-end demand forecasting process across all product categories, sales channels, and markets.
* Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts at the SKU, category, channel, and distribution center levels.
* Partner with Merchandising, Marketing, and eCommerce to incorporate product launches, promotional activities, seasonality, marketing investments, and business growth assumptions into forecasts.
* Lead forecast reviews, analyze actual performance against projections, identify demand trends, and continuously improve forecast accuracy.
* Develop forecasting methodologies for new product introductions, core replenishment products, and seasonal collections.
* Identify demand risks and opportunities early and recommend actions to optimize sales and inventory performance.

**Supply Planning & Purchasing**

* Translate demand forecasts into actionable supply and purchasing plans, considering inventory on hand, open purchase orders, production lead times, transportation lead times, and safety stock requirements.
* Own the inventory purchasing plan and recommend purchase order quantities, timing, and replenishment strategies.
* Partner with Global Sourcing and suppliers to align production capacity, lead times, and delivery schedules with business requirements.
* Support new product launches by ensuring purchase orders and inventory availability align with launch milestones.
* Proactively identify supply constraints, potential shortages, and excess inventory risks, developing mitigation plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Balance product availability with inventory investment and working capital objectives.

**Inventory Planning & Optimization**

* Develop and execute inventory strategies across multiple distribution centers in Canada and the US.
* Establish and manage inventory targets, safety stock policies, and SKU classifications based on demand patterns, product lifecycle, and business priorities.
* Monitor weeks of supply (WOS), inventory turns, stock availability, and aging inventory.
* Recommend inventory allocation and replenishment strategies across markets and distribution centers.
* Identify slow-moving and excess inventory and work with Merchandising and Marketing on appropriate actions.
* Optimize inventory positioning to improve service levels while minimizing carrying costs, transfers, and markdown exposure.

**Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)**

* Design, implement, and lead a structured monthly S&OP process, integrating commercial demand, supply capabilities, inventory investment, and financial objectives.
* Facilitate cross-functional planning discussions and drive alignment on a single, consensus-based operating plan.
* Partner with Finance to reconcile sales forecasts, inventory purchases, open-to-buy (OTB) plans, and financial targets.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into demand and supply risks, inventory requirements, and key business trade-offs.
* Develop scenario planning capabilities to support business decisions related to growth, promotions, product launches, and supply disruptions.
* Establish clear planning cadences, accountability, and decision-making processes.

**Product Launch & Lifecycle Planning**

* Partner with Product Development, Merchandising, and Sourcing to support seasonal assortment planning and new product introductions.
* Develop initial demand forecasts and inventory buy recommendations for new collections based on historical performance, comparable products, and commercial assumptions.
* Align purchasing decisions with product development milestones, supplier lead times, and launch dates.
* Monitor launch performance and recommend inventory reallocation, replenishment, or exit strategies.
* Manage inventory planning throughout the product lifecycle, including introduction, growth, replenishment, and end-of-life.

**Planning Systems, Analytics & Process Improvement**

* Build scalable planning processes, reporting tools, and performance dashboards.
* Improve data quality, forecasting methodologies, and planning visibility across functions.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual planning activities and improve decision-making through systems and analytics.
* Develop standardized planning metrics, reporting cadences, and exception-management processes.
* Partner with Finance, Operations, and Technology to strengthen planning tools and data integration.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Planning team, establishing clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a collaborative, accountable, and data-driven planning culture.
* Serve as the primary planning partner to Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Product Development, Global Sourcing, and Operations.
* Communicate complex planning information clearly and translate analysis into practical business recommendations.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and ensure timely decisions to support business priorities.

### **What You Bring to the Table**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, or integrated business planning.
* 5+ years of experience leading planning teams or functions.
* Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end planning in a consumer products, retail, fashion, accessories, or eCommerce environment.
* Strong understanding of demand forecasting, inventory optimization, replenishment planning, and open-to-buy management.
* Experience establishing or leading S&OP processes.
* Advanced analytical skills, including strong Excel and financial modeling capabilities.
* Experience working with ERP, inventory management, and demand planning systems.
* Strong communication, influencing, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with changing priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business with frequent seasonal product launches.
* Experience managing inventory across multiple countries, distribution centers, and sales channels.
* Knowledge of international sourcing, manufacturing lead times, and ocean freight logistics.
* Experience with Shopify, WMS, and business intelligence or planning tools.

### **The recruitment process**

* Video screen with Talent Advisor from Bloom
* Video Interview with Yongyi, COO
* Video Interview with Nat Bates, VP of Finance
* Video Interview with Nat Dusome, CEO and Founder
* Reference checks
* Offer

Applications will be accepted through the end of November. Candidates can expect to hear from us regarding next steps by November 30th 2026.

### **Location**

* We’re seeking an exceptional candidate based in the US or Canada who values the flexibility of remote work while embracing the excitement of in-person experiences.
* There will be occasional domestic and/or international travel for photoshoots, events, and team retreats.

### **Salary and Total Rewards**

* Annual Salary ranges from $150,000-$170,000
* Performance bonus
* 3 weeks of paid vacation per year
* Health benefits coverage
* $250 annual period & menstrual budget
* $1,000 annual allowance towards Poppy & Peonies product
* $400 home office setup allowance

*All compensation and benefit amounts are reflected in local currency (CAD/USD where applicable).*

At Bloom, we see conversations around compensation as a continuous discussion. We encourage you to share your desired compensation early in the interview process, but we also understand that as you learn more about the role and the full benefits package, your expectations might evolve. Don't worry - there will be plenty of opportunities throughout the process to revisit and adjust those conversations if needed.

**Our Commitment to you.**

Like Bloom, Poppy & Peonies is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equitable employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

We’re looking for motivated, compassionate people who are excited to contribute, grow with the team, and support the values that Poppy & Peonies believes in.

Poppy & Peonies is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Please inform us if you require any accommodation, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Requests for any accessibility-related assistance can be made to sarah@buildwithbloom.com.  
  
**We believe transparency matters, especially as technology evolves.**  
  
At Bloom, we may leverage AI as a supportive tool when developing role descriptions, interview questions, take home assignments, and interview guides, where appropriate, with the goal of improving clarity, consistency, and accessibility for candidates. However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates. Every application is reviewed by a human, every interview is conducted by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by people, not automated systems. Human judgment, care, and accountability are central to how we hire.  
  
**About Bloom**  
  
**Bloom** is a full-service workplace design consultancy representing Poppy & Peonies at they build their team. As Talent Advisors, we will be the liaison between our Bloom Partner and yourself during this recruitment process. We do not use fancy tech to search through resumes at Bloom; every resume is reviewed by a human to ensure that we attain a consistent and equitable interview process. You will directly join our client’s team if you are selected as the successful candidate. We look forward to seeing your application!

title: Director, Logistics & Order Management
description:

* Lead warehouse and distribution operations through 3PL partners, ensuring service levels, accuracy, and cost efficiency

title: Accelerator Program Associate
description:
**ABOUT HL7 INTERNATIONAL**

HL7 International is a global, member-driven non-profit dedicated to advancing healthcare data interoperability. The organization is accredited by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) as an international Standards Development Organization (SDO). Our widely adopted standards and frameworks are the foundation of health information exchange worldwide, enabling data to be shared, accessed, and applied to improve health outcomes and system performance.

We are entering an exciting new chapter of growth and transformation. Our strategic vision emphasizes brand recognition, revenue diversification and growth, and the ability to innovate in response to emerging healthcare challenges.

**Position Summary**

HL7 International is seeking an **Accelerator Program Associate** to provide dedicated program operations services to a portfolio of HL7’s FHIR® Accelerator programs, reporting to the Director, Resource Development.

  

HL7 FHIR Accelerators are collaborative, multi-stakeholder initiatives that operate under HL7’s organizational and fiduciary umbrella. They bring together payers, providers, vendors, government agencies, and standards experts to develop high-quality FHIR Implementation Guides and advance real-world interoperability. The Accelerator Program Associate serves as the primary operational point of contact for assigned Accelerator(s), ensuring that governance, project operations, financial administration, and HL7 coordination functions are executed with consistency, professionalism, and transparency.

  

This position is fully funded through direct charges to the Accelerator program(s), consistent with HL7’s cost allocation model for program-specific staff. It represents a foundational investment in HL7’s internal program management infrastructure and offers a significant opportunity for professional growth as HL7 continues to expand and mature its Accelerator portfolio.

  

The Accelerator Program Associate will be expected to participate in regular virtual meetings, some of which may occur across time zones, given the international nature of HL7’s work. Occasional travel to HL7 Working Group Meetings or Accelerator-related events may be required.

This is a fully remote position. HL7 is open to hiring candidates that reside in the following states: Illinois, Michigan, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, Florida, and Texas.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Governance**

* Manage the administrative operations of assigned Accelerator governance bodies, including Steering Committee(s) and Operating Committee(s).
* Coordinate meeting scheduling, agenda preparation, facilitation logistics, minutes, and action item tracking.
* Maintain governance documentation, membership rosters, and committee records.
* Onboard new Accelerator members and committee participants.
* Align governance processes with HL7 policies and Accelerator charters.

**2. HL7 & FHIR Accelerator Coordination**

* Serve as the primary administrative liaison between assigned Accelerator(s) and the broader HL7 ecosystem, including relevant Work Groups, product families, and project teams.
* Facilitate communication between Accelerator leadership and HL7 staff across departments (communications, finance, IT, legal, and others as needed).
* Stay current on HL7 policies, processes, and organizational developments relevant to Accelerator operations.
* Ensure cross-Accelerator coordination and knowledge-sharing as directed by the Director of Resource Development.

**3. Project Operations**

* Lead cross-workstream project operations, including milestone tracking, deliverable management, risk identification and mitigation.
* Maintain public-facing Accelerator artifacts, including websites and Confluence spaces.
* Coordinate scheduling and logistics for working group calls, task forces, and technical review sessions.
* Manage collaboration tools and document repositories on behalf of the Accelerator.
* Draft and distribute communications, newsletters, and meeting summaries to Accelerator communities.

**4. Financial & Contracting Administration**

* Act as the Accelerator’s primary liaison to HL7 Core Services on financial and contracting matters.
* Validate that financial reports produced by HL7 Core Services align with Accelerator project documentation and leadership expectations.
* Conduct the Accelerator’s annual and periodic budget development processes, coordinating inputs from Accelerator leadership and in compliance with guidance from HL7 finance staff.
* Monitor budget-to-actual performance on a monthly basis — review financial reports produced by HL7 Core Services, reconcile against internal project tracking, identify and investigate variances, and provide leadership with a plain-language summary and recommended corrective actions if needed.
* Manage contractor and vendor engagement  
  — initiate and coordinate Statement of Work (SOW) development for subject matter experts, vendors, and other contractors; track execution timelines, deliverable completion, and invoice approval workflows; flag scope creep or billing discrepancies to HL7 Core Services.
* Administer grant and external funding obligations  
  — maintain a tracking register of all grant-funded deliverables, reporting deadlines, and funder requirements; prepare or coordinate draft reports to funders; ensure expenditures remain aligned with approved grant budgets and flag any compliance risks.
* Maintain financial transparency with Accelerator stakeholders  
  — produce regular financial summaries for Steering Committee review, including budget status, upcoming spend commitments, and any material changes to the financial outlook.

  

**Qualifications and Required Skills**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in health informatics, public health, business administration, nonprofit management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in program or project management, preferably in a healthcare, health IT, standards development, or nonprofit environment.
* Demonstrated experience working with governance bodies, multi-stakeholder committees, or collaborative industry initiatives.
* Experience with financial administration, budget tracking, or contracting coordination is strongly preferred.

  

**Skills & Attributes**

* Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, healthcare interoperability standards, or health data ecosystems is highly desirable; a willingness and ability to develop this knowledge quickly is required.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholder groups simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear meeting documentation, summaries, and stakeholder communications.
* Proficiency with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Smartsheet, or equivalent).
* High degree of organizational rigor and attention to detail, particularly in financial and contractual matters.
* Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in a remote, distributed work environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a service-oriented approach to working with volunteer-driven, expert communities.
* Commitment to HL7’s mission of advancing global health data interoperability.

title: Copywriter
description:

PrePass® is a leading provider of innovative transportation solutions that help commercial fleets operate more efficiently, safely, and confidently. Through intelligent weigh station bypassing, toll management and compliance solutions, we help fleets reduce administrative complexity, improve operational performance, and keep drivers moving.

Our team combines industry expertise, technology, and customer-focused innovation to solve real challenges facing commercial transportation. We are passionate about delivering meaningful value to the fleets and drivers who keep our economy moving.

**Benefits**  

### **How We Will Take Care of You**

* Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.

**Join Us**

title: Associate Director of SEO & AI Growth Strategy
description:
**Associate Director of SEO & AI Growth Strategy**  
The Digital Stronghold - Remote Full-time

**Help five distinctive brands in a growing portfolio get found in search, and in what AI says.**

How people discover brands is changing quickly. Customers still search on Google, but they're also asking AI assistants what to buy. We're looking for a Director of Search and Discovery to make sure every brand in our portfolio is visible, accurately represented and recommended wherever customers are looking.

**About The Digital Stronghold**

The Digital Stronghold is home to a growing portfolio of consumer apparel and accessories brands, including Boston Scally, Taylor Stitch, The Tie Bar, Pedal Mafia and Glade Optics. Each brand has its own identity, customer and culture, from heritage menswear to unapologetic performance cycling to responsibly built outdoor apparel. We give them shared capabilities in people, finance, technology and operations, so they can grow further and faster than they could on their own, without losing what makes them different.

**The Role**

Reporting to the SVP of Consumer Marketing, you'll own organic search and AI-driven discovery across the portfolio. This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of influence. You'll set the strategy and standards, decide where effort will pay off most, and partner with brand teams and Product & Technology to make it happen.

**What You'll Do**

* Grow organic search and AI-referred traffic into profitable, scalable acquisition channels for every brand, and set targets with brand leaders.
* Build a search and discovery roadmap for each brand, prioritized by revenue impact, and manage one shared backlog across the portfolio.
* Keep every brand's site technically sound and easy for search engines and AI systems to understand, including crawlability, structured data, site speed and migrations.
* Make collection pages, product pages and editorial content work harder in search results and AI-generated answers, in partnership with brand, merchandising and copy teams.
* Track how each brand shows up in AI answers, fix gaps and inaccuracies, and test new approaches as search changes.
* Create a shared playbook and spread what works across brands, so a win for one brand benefits all of them.

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years of SEO and search marketing experience, ideally in ecommerce, with a track record of growing organic revenue.
* Experience supporting multiple brands or sites, in-house or at an agency.
* Strong technical SEO skills, including Shopify experience, plus Google Search Console, GA4 and a major SEO platform.
* The ability to write clear requirements for engineers and to influence teams without direct authority.
* Strong analytical skills, with a talent for turning data into clear recommendations for executives.
* Real curiosity about how AI is changing discovery, and an eagerness to test new approaches.

**Why Join Us**

* Shape search strategy across five distinctive brands at once.

title: Director of Supply Chain
description:
Description:

**Why join the GoMacro team?**

We’re a company that is driven by a unique core ideology we call The GoMacro Way, which is based upon authenticity, generosity, and compassion for people and the planet. We operate with integrity, we create with passion, and we conduct ourselves with humility. We seek growth-minded people who are inspired by challenges, encouraged by camaraderie, and excited about being leaders at every level. Become part of a team where everyone is heard, valued, and empowered to influence positive change in their local and global community.

**How GoMacro’s history shapes who we are today?**

During her 2003 battle with cancer, co-founder Amelia Kirchoff created the first MacroBar® recipe in her kitchen on the Wisconsin family farm. In the years following, Amelia and her daughter and co-founder Jola began spreading awareness for the power of a balanced, plant-based lifestyle through GoMacro’s healthy and delicious MacroBars, which are now available in stores nationwide.

Today, our work is still guided by the values upon which Jola and Amelia built GoMacro: Live Long, Eat Positive, Give Back, Tread Lightly, and Be Well. It’s our goal to inspire people to have a healthy body, sharp mind, and bold spirit—and we believe doing fun, and meaningful work is part of that.

**Join us as we make the world better, one bite at a time!**

**Position Description:**

GoMacro is creating a new Director of Supply Chain role to strengthen how we plan, align, and execute across our growing business. Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, this leader will oversee Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, and Logistics, with a mandate to build a world-class planning capability that connects commercial strategy to operational execution.

This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact at a growing, nationally distributed CPG brand. You'll lead an established team of planning and logistics managers, advance a demand planning transformation already underway, and help shape a more integrated, forward-looking Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.

Success requires more than technical expertise. We're seeking a leader who can translate complex data into clear business decisions, balance customer service with inventory and cost, build alignment across functions, and develop a high-performing team. This is a hands-on leadership role in an entrepreneurial environment. You'll set direction and develop the organization while remaining close enough to the details to challenge assumptions, solve problems, and drive meaningful improvements.

If you're energized by the opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing supply chain capability—and have the technical depth and leadership judgment to make it happen—we'd love to talk.

**What Success Looks Like in Your First Year:**

* A monthly S&OP cycle that runs on time and ends with clear decisions, accountabilities, and timely execution.
* An Executive S&OP that looks forward, surfaces risk early, and drives decisions rather than reviewing last month.
* A demand plan that Sales, Finance, and Operations trust, and is supported by consistent measurement and continuous improvement.
* Inventory policies that protect service levels while reducing excess and obsolete inventory.
* Clear decision rights between planning and manufacturing scheduling.
* Measurable improvement in customer service, forecast accuracy, schedule attainment, inventory turns, and supply chain cost, supported by disciplined planning and execution.
* Development plans for the team and a long-term organizational plan for enduring strength and resilience in our Supply Chain.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Lead S&OP and Executive S&OP**

* Lead and continuously improve the S&OP process, including facilitating Executive S&OP in partnership with the SVP of Operations and serving as the hub between Planning, Sales, Brand, Finance, Manufacturing Operations, and Procurement.
* Ensure executive decisions are informed by forward-looking scenarios, clear trade-offs, and actionable recommendations.

**Build a Demand Plan and process the Business Trusts**

* Lead Demand Planning, integrating sales history, account plans, commercial inputs, consumption data, and statistical models into one consensus plan.
* Strengthen the partnership between Sales account owners and Demand Planning so the right information reaches the plan at the right time.

**Turn Demand into an Executable Supply Plan**

* Lead Supply Planning and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), ensuring the supply plan drives sound procurement, scheduling, and capacity decisions.
* Direct the work of the master supply plan and planning time fences in partnership with Manufacturing Operations, which owns detailed production scheduling and execution.
* Partner closely with Procurement to translate material requirements into actionable purchasing plans, anticipate supplier constraints, and balance supply continuity, inventory investment, and total supply chain cost.
* Plan capacity across our own production lines and contract manufacturing partners.

**Optimize Inventory and Working Capital**

* Govern safety stock, reorder points, and inventory targets to protect service, increase turns, manage shelf-life risk, and reduce carrying costs, in partnership with Finance.
* Lead Logistics Through a Strong Team
* Lead warehouse operations, 3PL partners, direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce fulfillment, and transportation through the Sr. Manager of Logistics.

**See Risk Early and Act**

* Build forward-looking supply models and scenarios that expose service, inventory, and capacity risks before they affect customers, and mobilize the right functions to respond.

**Leverage Data to Drive Decisions**

* Advance planning analytics, reporting, and adoption of improved planning tools and processes, including Microsoft Fabric and business intelligence (BI); establish supply chain performance metrics aligned with enterprise objectives.

**Lead, Steer, and Develop**

* Lead and develop three direct reports — the Demand Planning Manager, Supply Planning Manager, and Sr. Manager of Logistics — staying close enough to the planning work to guide it, troubleshoot it, and ensure its quality.

Requirements:

**Skills & Experience Required:**

* 10+ years of progressive supply chain planning experience in food, CPG, or similarly complex manufacturing environments, including at least 5 years leading planning teams.
* A track record of building or significantly maturing an S&OP or Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.
* Confidence facilitating executive-level decision forums, framing trade-offs for senior leaders and engaging every stakeholder group.
* Deep technical expertise in demand forecasting, MRP, master production scheduling, capacity planning, and inventory optimization.
* Experience planning across both internal manufacturing and contract manufacturing.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and ERP planning modules.
* A low-ego, engaged leadership style, with a deep enough command of the planning work to guide and troubleshoot it, and comfort with ambiguity in a growing organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ASCM/APICS CPIM or CSCP certification, or an MBA.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or similar data platforms.
* Experience leading logistics, warehousing, or D2C fulfillment functions.
* Experience managing shelf-life-sensitive inventory.

**Work Environment:**

This remote position operates within a collaborative, values-based environment that spans office-based work, manufacturing operations, and warehouse and logistics operations, with regular engagement at our Viola, WI manufacturing headquarters. Time in manufacturing and warehouse areas requires adherence to food safety, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and safety requirements.

**Travel Required:**

Up to 25% travel per year, including visits to our Viola, WI headquarters and other operational partners, as needed.

**Salary & Benefits:**

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $155,000 - $190,000. This range reflects our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. This role may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as a discretionary annual company performance bonus of 15%.

GoMacro offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and wellness-focused benefits. For more details, please view our careers page: www.gomacro.com/careers.

description:
**About Ozlo**

Ozlo is a health tech company transforming how the world sleeps. We design and manufacture an ecosystem of sleep solutions, including the Ozlo Sleepbuds®, that use sophisticated technology and sound to unlock restorative sleep. Join a collaborative, fast-paced, global team focused on helping millions of people sleep better. You will shape the product people sleep with every night as we grow from consumer wellness into clinical health.

The base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $200,000 per year. Actual compensation offered will depend on a candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

US benefits listed; competitive local pension and health benefits provided for Dublin hires.

title: Safety Director
description:
**Join Capstone Mechanical as a** **Safety Director**

**Location:** Remote (Must reside in our service territory: ME, NH, VT, MA, NY, CT, RI, NJ, PA, DE, MD, VA, WV, OH, TN, NC, SC)  
**Schedule:** Full-Time | Monday–Friday (Optional on-call rotation with additional stipend)

***Are you passionate about creating a culture where safety comes first, people feel empowered, and continuous improvement drives meaningful change******?***

At Capstone Mechanical, we believe that taking care of our people starts with keeping them safe. Safety isn't simply a requirement or a checklist; it's a commitment we make to one another, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We're looking for an experienced, people-focused Safety Director to lead and continuously strengthen our company-wide safety program. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, developing practical solutions, and creating a proactive safety culture across a growing, multi-state organization.

As our Safety Director, you'll partner with team members at every level of the organization to bring our Safety Always value to life, champion our Zero Harm philosophy, and ensure every team member has the knowledge, resources, and confidence to work safely.

**About Capstone Mechanical**

Since 2011, Capstone has delivered exceptional commercial HVAC/R service, maintenance, and installation to some of the nation’s top brands. Our mission is to build meaningful relationships - with our customers and with each other - by operating with care, transparency, and excellence.

**Why** **You’ll** **Love Working with Us**

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**

* Culture rooted in trust, transparency, and growth

* Remote flexibility with collaborative team support

* Direct contribution to business results and team performance

**What** **You’ll** **Accomplish**

As our Safety Director, you'll play a critical role in developing, leading, and continuously improving our safety practices across all locations and service teams. You'll work closely with technicians, General Managers, executive leadership, our Fleet Manager, customers, and insurance partners to create a safer workplace for everyone.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

**Safety Program Leadership & Compliance**

* Lead and continuously improve Capstone's company-wide safety program, ensuring compliance with OSHA and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

* Develop and maintain practical safety policies, procedures, and guidelines that support our field-based teams.

* Champion our Safety Always value and foster a proactive Zero Harm culture throughout the organization.

* Empower team members to exercise stop-work authority whenever they identify unsafe conditions, partnering with operational leaders to resolve concerns.

* Conduct safety audits, field observations, and risk assessments to identify opportunities for prevention and improvement.

* Partner with leadership to ensure safety remains a foundational part of our operations and decision-making.

**Safety Training & Development**

* Lead the development, coordination, delivery, and tracking of company-wide safety training programs.

* Ensure all technicians complete required OSHA 10 training and identify additional training needs based on job responsibilities.

* Oversee safety onboarding for new team members and ongoing refresher training throughout employment.

* Maintain accurate training and compliance records, monitor completion rates, and proactively address gaps.

* Develop engaging, practical training opportunities that encourage participation, understanding, and accountability.

**Incident Investigation & Prevention**

* Lead investigations involving workplace injuries, accidents, near misses, and vehicle incidents.

* Conduct root cause analyses to understand contributing factors and develop meaningful corrective actions.

* Maintain required OSHA reporting, recordkeeping, and incident documentation.

* Track corrective actions through completion and evaluate their effectiveness.

* Identify trends and share lessons learned to prevent future incidents and strengthen safety practices.

**Fleet & Driving Safety**

* Partner closely with our Fleet Manager to promote safe driving practices and strengthen fleet safety standards.

* Review telematics and motor vehicle record (MVR) information provided by the Fleet Manager to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Develop coaching, training, and prevention initiatives that support safe driving behaviors.

* Collaborate on vehicle accident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk reduction efforts.

**Customer Site Safety**

* Work collaboratively with customers and operational teams to address unsafe conditions identified at customer locations.

* Support technicians in raising safety concerns and ensure those concerns are taken seriously and addressed appropriately.

* Build positive, solutions-focused relationships with customers while reinforcing our commitment to safety and Customer Care.

* Escalate unresolved safety concerns when additional leadership support is needed.

**Reporting & Risk Management**

* Develop monthly safety reports for leadership, highlighting key performance indicators, incident trends, open concerns, and improvement opportunities.

* Prepare quarterly safety updates for the Board, including incident summaries, safety objectives, and progress toward improvement initiatives.

* Collaborate with insurance brokers and captive insurance partners to identify risk management opportunities and implement best practices.

* Participate in captive safety meetings and represent Capstone's safety initiatives as needed.

* Use data and measurable outcomes to guide decisions and continuously strengthen safety performance.

**Safety Culture, Communication & Coaching**

* Serve as a trusted safety resource and partner to technicians, General Managers, and team leaders.

* Create opportunities for open, honest conversations about safety, encouraging team members to speak up and share concerns.

* Coach leaders on reinforcing safe behaviors, accountability, and proactive risk prevention.

* Promote our Innovation by All principle by encouraging team members to share ideas that make our workplace safer.

* Recognize and celebrate safe behaviors, positive contributions, and improvements in safety performance.

* Partner across departments to ensure safety is integrated into everyday operations rather than treated as a separate initiative.

**What** **We’re** **Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* **People-Focused** – You genuinely care about the well-being of others and believe safety starts with trust, communication, and respect.

* **A Collaborative Leader** – You build strong relationships, work across teams, and influence positive change through partnership rather than authority alone.

* **Proactive & Solutions-Oriented** – You identify risks early, think critically, and focus on practical solutions that prevent incidents.

* **A Strong Communicator & Coach** – You can translate complex safety requirements into clear, meaningful guidance that resonates with team members at every level.

* **Analytical & Detail-Oriented** – You use data, trends, and observations to identify opportunities and make informed recommendations.

* **Accountable & Dependable** – You take ownership, follow through on commitments, and lead by example.

* **Committed to Continuous Improvement** – You believe there is always an opportunity to learn, grow, and make processes safer and more effective.

**Basic Requirements:**

* Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and managing safety programs for a multi-state, field-based workforce.

* Strong working knowledge of OSHA regulations, workplace safety requirements, and fleet and driving safety practices.

* Experience leading incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

* Experience developing and delivering safety training and educational programs.

* Strong communication, coaching, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

* Ability to analyze safety data, identify trends, and communicate actionable recommendations to leadership.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong partnerships across the organization.

* Willingness and ability to travel to customer locations, field operations, and insurance partner meetings as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Health and Safety, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

* OSHA 30-Hour certification or higher, such as OSHA 500.

* Previous experience supporting HVAC/R, mechanical, construction, or field service operations.

* Experience supporting safety programs across multiple states and geographically dispersed teams.

**Working Conditions & Travel:**

This is a remote position with travel to customer sites, field locations, and insurance partner meetings as needed. Travel requirements will vary based on business needs. Field visits may include mechanical rooms, rooftops, and other commercial service environments requiring appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).

**Our Benefits** **& Perks**

* **Wellness Program** with premium discounts

* **Personal and Professional Development Opportunities**

**Ready to build your career with a company that invests in you?**  
Apply today and be part of something meaningful.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Our decisions and criteria governing the employment relationship with all employees are non-discriminatory and are based on job requirements and an individual’s skills and experience without regard to race, creed, color, gender (including pregnancy), religion, age, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, veteran status, disability, gender identity or expression, or any other status protected by state or federal law. It is our intent that such factors shall not be a consideration for any of the following: employment, retention, promotion, recruitment or recruitment advertisement, rates of pay or other forms of compensation, administration of benefits,* *selection* *for job or management training, and demotion or separation. All matters related to employment are based upon the ability to perform the job, plus dependability and reliability once hired**.*

description:

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.  
  
We're growing, and we're currently looking for a Director, Gift and Swag Management to join us.  
  
**About** **the Role**

As Director, Gift and Swag Management at Reachdesk, you will lead Reachdesk's efforts to offer our clients the widest range of gifts and branded merchandise at affordable prices. To drive these efforts you will manage Reachdesk's Swag Sourcing and Marketplace Teams, each owning a portion of Reachdesk's holistic gifting offering, and develop effective strategies for how these teams can increase adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are solutions-oriented, and have a passion for startups and growing a business in a new market.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Set and manage team performance targets focused on maximizing adoption and profitability
* Hire and performance manage people managers and individual contributors across your organization
* Spearhead opportunities to expand Reachdesk's gifting and merchandise options across different verticals and regions internationally
* Manage a strategic roadmap of new opportunities to optimize and develop your teams performance both internally and externally
* Create automations, calculators, and playbooks that enable consistent best practices across your teams
* Develop clear best practices for how your teams services are sold by other members of the Reachdesk organization to ensure clients leverage these services to the best possible outcomes

  

**About You**

* 5 years experience or more as a leader and people manager in the Project Management or Branded Merchandise Space
* Experience working with or working at a 3rd Party Logistics Warehouse
* Expertise with WMS systems or other relevant ordering, process and fulfillment systems
* A degree in Supply Chain Management or Logistics Management is ideal
* Expertise using business intelligence tools like Looker, Tableau, Zoho, Sisense, or PowerBI for both analyzing data and developing client facing dashboards
* Confident presenting in front of clients and conveying concepts to non-experts
* A natural ability to prioritize multiple streams of work across both internal and external stakeholders
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills

**The Benefits**

* Competitive salary with generous stock options
* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental & vision insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care

title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

title: Director, Organic Growth & Discovery
description:
**Who is Credible?**

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

**About the Role:**

Credible is seeking an analytical, product-minded leader to own how consumers discover Credible online. The way people find financial products is evolving at a rapid pace. Search is turning into AI answers, and the decision to compare a loan or an insurance policy is moving beyond Google to AI platforms, Reddit, YouTube, or TikTok. We are uniquely positioned to be the trusted answer wherever that search begins.

In this role, you will own and scale organic discovery across Credible.com and our tier-1 publishing partners. SEO is the foundation but; the role spans everything SEO is becoming: traditional search, AI answer engines, and social and community platforms. You will also own the performance of the pages that organic traffic lands on, turning visits into completed applications through rigorous conversion rate optimization.

This is a highly visible role, both inside Credible and across our publisher partner network. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Editorial, Partnerships, and Paid Marketing, while leading a team of SEO and content specialists. The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, thinks like a product manager, and is grounded in revenue-based decisions. They can explain in dollars what happened, why it happened, and what we're doing about it. You will thrive in a fast-moving environment and are passionate about helping consumers make great financial decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and lead Credible's organic discovery strategy across Credible.com and our tier-1 publishing partners, spanning SEO, AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), and social and community platforms (Reddit, YouTube, TikTok).
* Win visibility in AI-generated answers by understanding how large language models retrieve, summarize, and cite content, making our pages and product data easy to use and cite, and building presence in the off-site sources those models draw on, including forums, publishers, and earned media.
* Lead technical SEO at scale, including crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and schema, partnering closely with our Content Platform engineering team.
* Own conversion rate optimization for organic entry pages: set page and template requirements, build and run a disciplined A/B testing program, and partner with Product to improve the journey from first visit to completed application.
* Act as a product owner for organic experiences, writing clear requirements, prioritizing a roadmap with Product and Engineering, and shipping improvements that move both traffic and conversion.
* Bring analytical rigor to every decision: separate competitive non-brand traffic from brand and direct demand, tie organic performance to revenue, and diagnose changes in performance down to the query, page, and funnel stage.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks that track leading indicators and long-term outcomes, including rankings, AI citations and share of voice, conversion rate, and revenue per visit.
* Reporting to leadership and stakeholders, with clear communication on KPIs, initiatives, and overall portfolio performance.
* Build authority through digital PR, expert contributors, and partner content that strengthens trust and E-E-A-T in a regulated, high-trust category.
* Conduct opportunity sizing and ROI modeling to prioritize verticals, queries, and platforms, balancing near-term revenue impact with durable brand authority.
* Build and lead a high-performing team of SEO and content specialists, setting a high bar for craft, testing discipline, and clear communication.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, using data, insights, and testing to continuously refine how consumers find and choose Credible.
* Stay at the forefront of search, AI discovery, analytics, and conversion best practices to keep Credible ahead of the curve.

**Education & Experience**

We know the "perfect" candidate doesn't exist, so if you meet most of the criteria below and are excited about the opportunity, we'd love to hear from you:

* 8+ years of experience in SEO and organic growth, with senior leadership of an organic or growth function, ideally at a marketplace, publisher, or consumer fintech.
* Proven track record of growing non-brand organic demand and tying it to revenue, not just traffic.
* Hands-on, current experience improving brand visibility in AI answer engines, with a point of view on how to measure it.
* Demonstrated success in conversion rate optimization, including designing and running A/B tests on high-traffic pages.
* Strong product sense, with a history of writing requirements and shipping with Product and Engineering teams.
* Advanced analytical skills, with fluency in Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and SQL or Looker.
* Experience with YMYL content and compliance review; financial services experience a plus.
* Experience working with publishers or media partners a plus.
* 4+ years of people management, with a passion for coaching and scaling teams.

**Why work at Credible?**

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we're the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we'll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Meaningful is a brand consultancy, closer to a senior collective than a traditional agency. Everyone on the team is a seasoned creative or maker who loves building brands and getting their hands dirty in the craft. We help brands find a meaningful place in the world, and we start with one question: can you state the goal of your company without using numbers or dollar signs?

We believe in humanizing brands. Social is where a brand either sounds like a person or sounds like noise, and we're looking for someone who knows the difference.

**The role**

You'll own Meaningful's social presence, and support social work for select clients. That means shaping what we say, how it looks, when it goes out, and what we learn from it. You'll work closely with our founders, our design team and the Director of Social to turn our point of view into posts people actually stop for.

**What you'll do**

Content strategy and planning

* Build and maintain a monthly content calendar across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and other channels as they make sense.
* Turn our thinking (founder perspectives, case studies, books, events) into a steady rhythm of posts, series and campaigns.
* Bring ideas, not just schedules. Know what's worth saying and why.

Writing and production

* Write captions, threads and short-form copy in Meaningful's voice: conversational, insightful, warm but direct.
* Partner with designers on visuals and short video, and give clear briefs and feedback.
* Keep everything on brand, from tone to type to the way we use color.

Publishing and community

* Move posts through review and approval on time, and keep the calendar current in Notion.
* Respond to comments and messages, and build real relationships with the people and brands in our orbit.
* Keep an eye on what peers, clients and the culture are talking about.

Measurement and learning

* Track performance monthly and report what's working, what isn't, and what we should try next.
* Care about the right numbers (saves, shares, meaningful conversations, inbound) over vanity metrics.

Client support

* Support account leads on client social projects: audits, content plans, launch campaigns and handoffs.

**What you bring**

* 3 to 5 years managing social media, ideally at a brand consultancy, creative agency or in-house brand team.
* A portfolio of accounts or campaigns you've run, with results you can talk about.
* Sharp writing. You can say something real in a sentence.
* A strong visual eye, and comfort working alongside designers (Figma or Canva familiarity is a plus).
* Experience with scheduling and analytics tools (Buffer, Later, Sprout or similar), Notion, Slack and Google Workspace.
* Organized, reliable and calm under deadlines.
* Genuine interest in storytelling and humanized branding. You'd rather change minds than chase likes.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with B2B or thought-leadership content on LinkedIn.
* Short-form video editing skills.
* Experience with paid social.

**Benefits**

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Work alongside senior creatives with long resumes and the awards to match

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a link to your portfolio or two to three accounts you've managed. Tell us, in a few sentences, about a post you made that you're proud of and why it worked.

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

* Video editing: 3 years (Required)
